record.description: A two-level cat window perch that suction-mounts to glass for a sunny view. Its sturdy metal frame and removable plush mattress keep resting kitties comfortable, and the adjustable middle layer gives cats room to stand and climb. Suits top-hung windows and saves floor space.
A women's black wrap slipper from Merrell's District line. It features a Select GRIP outsole designed to provide durable traction where you need it. Sized 5 US medium.

specs.care: Machine washable, cold water, tumble dry low

record.description: A long buffalo plaid table runner in black and white with a farmhouse look. Made from a cotton and polyester blend, it is machine washable and holds its shape well. Suited to dining, banquet, and buffet tables, and to indoor or outdoor use for holidays, parties, and everyday meals.

specs.package dimensions: 2.8 L x 4.8 W x 13 H cm

record.description: A black case for a Harley Tec X linerlock knife, designed to hold and protect the blade and handle when carried or stored. Compact in size, it suits everyday carry and outdoor use. Made in China.

specs.features: Built-in water bottle holder, phone/accessory holder

record.description: An indoor stationary exercise bike for home cardio workouts. It has a 30-pound flywheel with manual resistance control, a padded seat that adjusts on two axes, and adjustable aero handlebars. A built-in bottle holder and phone holder are included.

specs.features: Adjustable S-shape padded shoulder straps
specs.care: Water resistant, easy to clean

record.description: A lightweight red camouflage backpack for elementary-aged children. It has a main compartment with a laptop sleeve, a medium middle pocket, two small front zip pockets, and mesh side pockets that fit a water bottle. Padded adjustable shoulder straps and a top handle make it easy to carry.

specs.care: Machine washable cold, tumble dry low

record.description: Airy linen-blend curtain panels with a natural open weave and a soft, simple texture. Each panel has nickel grommets for easy hanging. They filter daylight while offering everyday privacy, suiting a range of home decor styles.

A long-wearing nail polish from Sally Hansen's Xtreme Wear line, offering a glossy, vivid finish in the Iris Illusion shade. Formulated to resist chipping and hold up to everyday wear, and sized at 0.4 fluid ounces.

specs.product type: Mug tree / mug and teacup storage rack
specs.care: Wipe with damp cloth and towel dry
specs.features: Carrying handle, curved branches

record.description: A countertop mug tree that stores six mugs or teacups vertically by their handles, freeing up cabinet space. Its curved branches keep cups in place, and a looped top handle makes it easy to move between counter and coffee station. Finished in a classic black with a modern look.

A men's jacket from Carhartt in a Shadow colorway, built with water-repellent finishing to shed light rain. Stretch fabric and flexible elbows allow easy movement, and a bi-swing back provides room across the shoulders.

specs.dimensions: 24.5 x 13 x 13 in (H x L x W)

record.description: A tall, collapsible laundry hamper with two removable bags so one can be swapped out while the other is taken to the wash. The sturdy Oxford fabric body stays upright on fiber rods, and the frame folds flat for storage or travel. Suited to laundry rooms, apartments, and dorms.

A collectible prize figure of Echidna from the Re:Zero series, shown in her Mandarin dress version. Made by Taito as part of its Coreful line, it comes with a base stand for display. An official licensed product for fans of the anime.

specs.closures: Zippered waist pocket, drawcord adjustable hem

record.description: A black women's down jacket with 700 fill power goose down insulation and a reflective Omni-Heat lining to retain warmth. The waterproof, breathable shell is fully seam sealed and offers four-way stretch. Includes a removable, helmet-compatible hood, underarm venting, a zippered pocket, and an adjustable hem and cuffs.

Anti-slip ankle socks for infants and toddlers, with round rubber grips on the sole to help little ones keep their footing while walking, crawling, or playing. Made of medium-thickness combed cotton that is breathable and stretchy, with a loose ankle cuff and smooth heel tabs for easy on and off. Sold in multi-pair value packs in a range of colors.

An unframed canvas wall print reproducing Edward Hopper's painting People in the Sun, suited to living rooms, bedrooms, offices and cafes. Printed in high definition with vivid colors on thick glossy canvas for lasting durability. Each panel ships individually packaged in a sturdy box.

A solid grey men's dress shirt with a fitted cut that is roomier through the shoulders, chest, and arms and tapers at the waist. Wrinkle-free poplin for easy care, a classic point collar, adjustable two-position cuffs, and a chest pocket.

specs.assembled dimensions: 39.5 L x 17.56 W x 14.4 H inches

record.description: A classic red steel wagon with 10-inch rubber tires for a smooth ride. It has an extra-long pull handle that folds under for storage and a controlled turning radius to reduce tipping. Suited for hauling small children, gardening soil and plants, coolers, and sports gear.

specs.strap style: Back adjustable straps, convertible traditional or crisscross

record.description: A wirefree everyday bra offering full coverage in lightly lined cups for a smooth, modest silhouette. Its silky fabric lays sleek under clothing, and the back straps convert between traditional and crisscross styles for a comfortable, supportive fit.

specs.material: Wheat straw fiber and food-grade PP

record.description: A set of four lightweight, unbreakable cereal bowls made from wheat straw fiber and food-grade PP. Holds 24 ounces, with deep sides and smooth rounded edges suited to cereal, salad, noodles, and fruit. Dishwasher and microwave safe, and free of BPA.
A dark blue cake topper with a sparkly glitter number one, designed to decorate a baby boy's first birthday cake. It arrives pre-assembled and can also serve as a photo prop for cake smash shoots.

Maintenance-free flanged sleeve bearing made from SAE 841 sintered bronze, which is mostly copper. It resists wear and corrosion and suits general-purpose use at moderate speeds and loads. Dimensions are 12 mm inner diameter, 15 mm outer diameter, and 12 mm length, with an 18 mm flange.

specs.media_width_range: 8.3 to 24 in sheets; 11 to 24 in rolls
specs.media_handling: Sheet feed, roll feed, input tray, automatic cutter
specs.mobile_printing: Android and Chrome OS apps; HP Smart app for iOS and Android

record.description: A compact large-format plotter for architects, engineers, and builders working in home or small offices. Prints sheets and rolls up to 24 inches wide, with an automatic cutter and wired or wireless connections, plus printing from mobile devices.

specs.features: 4-way stretch, expandable shoulders, reinforced snaps

record.description: A five-pack of sleeveless white bodysuits for babies sized 6 to 12 months. The stretchy, soft fabric moves with the baby, and expandable shoulders make dressing easier. Reinforced snaps are built to hold up through frequent washing.

A set of three stainless steel mixing bowls in 1.5, 3, and 5-quart sizes for whisking, mixing, marinating, and serving. The lightweight, commercial-grade bowls resist staining, odors, and rust, stack to save space, and can go in the refrigerator, freezer, and dishwasher.

specs.care: Machine or hand washable

record.description: A summer short dress with a V neckline, butterfly short sleeves, and a high-waisted A-line cut. Its all-over print adds a bright touch, and it suits casual everyday wear. The fabric has no stretch, so refer to the size chart before ordering.

A green cactus-patterned neck lanyard with a card holder for two ID cards. Made from soft polyester with printing on both sides, it is designed to be comfortable against bare skin and includes a sturdy metal clasp for keys. Suitable as a gift for women and friends.

A loose-fitting short-sleeve Halloween tee with a playful Sanderson Sisters graphic and an 'I Smell Children' letter print. Made from a soft, stretchy, breathable cotton blend, it pairs easily with jeans, leggings, or boots for fall and winter wear.

specs.card slots: 9 credit card slots plus 1 photo slot
specs.features: RFID blocking, 1 coin pocket, 1 full-length bill compartment

record.description: A compact bi-fold wallet for women with RFID blocking to help shield cards from unauthorized scanning. Made from genuine cowhide leather with an embossed checkered pattern, it holds several cards, a coin pocket, and folded bills while staying slim and flat.

Roll-up storage bags for packing clothes and linens when traveling. Each set includes three large suitcase bags and five medium carry-on bags. Push out the air by rolling, with no vacuum required. Helps protect contents from bugs, moths, dirt, mildew, and odors.

A moderate-mileage running shoe with gel cushioning in the rear and forefoot to soften impact and support a smooth stride. The outsole is built to resist wear in high-impact areas, and the removable sockliner makes room for a medical orthotic.

specs.assembly: Easy to assemble, all hardware included

record.description: A white three-cube storage organizer with an open back and sturdy frame, finished on both front and back. It can stand vertically or horizontally and is sized to hold 13-inch fabric storage bins. Hardware is included for simple assembly.

A vintage-style women's handbag in solid brown patent PU leather with a soft polyester lining. It has a magnetic snap and zipper closure, a reinforced bottom, and a removable metal chain strap that can be carried by hand, on the shoulder, or crossbody. It suits everyday outings, dates, and formal occasions.

A slim protective case made for the iPhone XR. It has a matte, non-smooth clear back and soft TPU sides that absorb drops and bumps. Cutouts give easy access to buttons and ports, and the raised front edge helps protect the screen.

specs.style: Short sleeve bodysuit with snap crotch

record.description: A short-sleeve baby bodysuit in black featuring a retro 90s sitcom quote print. Made from soft, pre-shrunk ring-spun cotton with a snap crotch for easy changes. Printed in the USA, it suits baby showers, birthdays, and holiday gifts.
A women's western cowboy boot from Ariat in a brown floral pattern. It features a Duratread outsole for durability and comes in US women's size 11 medium width.

Automatic electric running boards that extend when the door opens and retract when it closes. Built from die-cast aluminum with a corrosion-resistant coated finish, and includes an integrated low-profile LED light. Made in the USA.

A slim sterling silver box chain with a lobster claw clasp, rhodium plated for a bright shine and resistance to tarnish. Lightweight and sturdy, it sits comfortably at the collarbone and suits everyday wear. It also works well as a base for a pendant or as a gift.
A large green shark-shaped pencil eraser meant for correcting big mistakes on schoolwork, homework, and office paperwork. Makes a fun back-to-school gift.

A women's midi dress with a navy striped pattern and a fitted sheath silhouette. It has short cap sleeves, a round neckline, and a hidden back zip. Made of stretchy polyester, it suits work, church, or business occasions. Runs slightly small, so consider sizing up.
Replacement aerator from Delta for Neo Style lavatory faucets. Rated at 2.2 gallons per minute, it has a 55/64 inch by 27 female thread and a chrome finish. Country of origin is China.

specs.care: Machine washable and dryer safe

record.description: A lightweight men's button-up shirt blending linen and cotton for airy breathability in warm weather. Its narrow collar and rolled sleeves suit everything from business casual to weekend wear. The slim cut is fitted at the shoulders and trim through the chest and torso. Durable fabric can go straight into the washer and dryer.

specs.fit: Close to the body, fitted slim silhouette

record.description: A lightweight men's t-shirt with a soft slub cotton jersey knit and a close, slim fit. Finished with a V-neckline and a chest pocket, it is an everyday basic from the Amazon brand Goodthreads, offered in a pampas yellow tone.

specs.use: Indoor or outdoor

record.description: A black rubber floor mat with a textured cleat surface to reduce slipping on inclined paths, ramps, and damp floors. Suited to entryways, walkways, boat docks, and high-traffic retail or apartment areas, it also helps protect subfloors. Lightweight and easy to move and install.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, tumble dry low

record.description: A white cotton throw with an old-fashioned, lightly distressed style and decorative fringe. Drape it over a couch or chair for warmth and a touch of charm, or use it as a picnic or camping blanket and for wrapping gifts.

specs.care: Hand wash with mild detergent

record.description: A heavyweight 10-inch aluminum pan designed for baking classic angel food cakes. Its sturdy build spreads heat gently and evenly, and the nonstick surface helps cakes release cleanly and makes cleanup simpler. Hand washing with mild detergent is recommended.

specs.material: Hard plastic back with flexible silicone bumper

record.description: A clear protective case for the iPhone 11 Pro Max that keeps the phone's original look visible. It has a slim profile, a hard back, and a soft silicone bumper for grip, with reinforced corners intended to absorb drops. Wireless charging is supported.

specs.outsole: Direct injected one-component PU with shock point

record.description: A men's black oxford shoe from ECCO with a bike-toe shape and blind-eyelet lacing. Double-stitched seams add durability, and a moisture-wicking lining with ventilation keeps feet comfortable. The direct-injected PU outsole includes a shock point for cushioning.

specs.included: 4-in and 12-in extensions, 4 pressure mount kits, 4 wall cups, mounting kit

record.description: A pressure-mounted steel safety gate with a walk-through door that fits doorways and stairways from about 29 to 47 inches wide. Includes extension kits, mounting hardware, and wall cups for added security. Suited to children roughly 6 to 24 months old and wipes clean.

Men's low-cut soccer shoe built for artificial turf play. Features a regular fit and a Demonscale 3D-printed strike zone for enhanced ball control. Available in a Core Black, White, and Active Red colorway, size 11.5.

specs.accessories: 3 ropes (5 ft each), stainless steel D-rings

record.description: A triangular sun shade sail in sand color for patios, gardens, pools, and lawns. Made from new high density polyethylene fabric that blocks up to 95% of UV rays while letting air and water pass through. Includes ropes and stainless steel D-rings for easy installation.

specs.fit: High waisted flare palazzo wide leg
specs.care: Hand wash cold, do not bleach, hang dry

record.description: High waisted flare palazzo pants with a supportive waistband that sits comfortably and helps prevent sagging. Made from soft peachskin fabric with a stretchy blend for everyday comfort. Wide leg silhouette in a solid chakra blue shade. Hand wash cold and hang dry.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle; tumble dry low or air dry

record.description: A reversible queen comforter set with two matching pillow shams, filled with soft polyester down alternative for warmth in any season. The brushed microfiber cover feels soft and light. Hypoallergenic fill suits allergy sufferers, and the set is easy to care for in a home washer.

specs.light source: CREE XM-L T6 LED, up to 800 lm
specs.beam distance: Up to 20+ feet on brightest setting

record.description: A bright, lightweight LED headlamp with an 800 lumen light, three modes including strobe, and a zoom function to widen or focus the beam. Its adjustable elastic headband and 90 degree tilting head suit running, hiking, camping, fishing, and repair work. Splash resistant, but not for submersion.

A keto-friendly snack box holding five lemon vanilla protein wafer crisps. Each vanilla-covered wafer has a lemon filling and offers a filling, low-carb option for those following a low carb lifestyle.

Women's mid rise bootcut jeans in a stretchy cotton and Lycra blend for comfortable all-day wear. Flame-resistant and rated to NFPA 70E, NFPA 2112, and CAT 2 standards for hazardous work settings. Features an embroidered back pocket detail and an entwined pattern that suits both work and casual looks.

specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: Slip-on women's house slippers with a soft fleece lining and wool-like plush upper. A memory foam insole cushions and supports the feet, while the rubber sole offers traction for indoor and outdoor wear. Machine washable for easy care.

specs.pockets: 5-pocket styling with coin pocket and hammer loop

record.description: Lightweight garment-washed carpenter jeans from Dickies with a relaxed straight fit that allows easy bending and kneeling. Made from soft 100% cotton duck with triple-stitched seams, brass rivets, and multiple utility pockets.

specs.set contents: 2-piece his and hers ring set with gift box

record.description: A matching his and hers wedding and engagement ring set. Her ring has a prong-set round cubic zirconia center stone, and his is a polished 8mm comfort-fit band. Both are made of nickel-free 316L stainless steel and come packaged in a gift box.

specs.compatibility: Binoculars without a threaded tripod socket

record.description: A universal adapter that lets binoculars without a built-in threaded tripod socket be mounted on a standard tripod. It uses a common 1/4-inch-20 screw thread, so it fits most tripods with that standard connection.

specs.care: Machine wash and dry

record.description: A plush, slip-on spa thong slipper with a memory foam footbed that cushions and supports the heel and arch. Its flip-flop style and skid-resistant rubber sole suit indoor and outdoor use, and it is machine washable.

specs.fit: Sock length fits over the calf
specs.features: Arch support, seamless toe closure, non-cushion
specs.material: High performance yarns with moisture management and odor control

record.description: Moderate graduated compression socks for women, designed for everyday wear, travel, long periods of sitting or standing, and exercise. The four-zone compression aims to help reduce swelling and leg fatigue, with arch support, a seamless toe, and a non-cushioned feel.

A loose, lightweight women's tunic with a solid black finish and a flared, high-low hem. Its 3/4 roll-tab sleeves and notch neck collar add a casual touch. The soft, stretchy blend pairs easily with leggings, jeans, or pants.

specs.fit: Adjusts to bags up to 72 inches

record.description: A black luggage strap from Samsonite that cinches around suitcases for added identification. It has a rugged ABS buckle and a polypropylene strap that adjusts to fit bags up to 72 inches. It does not include a lock.

A classic Western-style ankle bootie with a V cutout at the front and a chunky stacked block heel of about 1.5 inches. Slips on easily with an inner zip, has a lightly padded footbed, and is made from vegan man-made materials for everyday wear.

A set of 69 vinyl PVC stickers themed on the Futurama cartoon series. Suited for decorating laptops, skateboards, bicycles, luggage, backpacks, and similar surfaces. Sized roughly 1 to 3 inches each, appealing to kids, teens, and adults alike.

Slip-on strappy sandals for women with lightweight, super-soft LiteRide foam insoles that provide cushioned comfort. Croslite foam outsoles offer durable support for all-day wear, and the flexible gore uppers feel comfortable from the first wear. Runs with a relaxed fit, so consider sizing up.

specs.paper: High quality paper stock from well-managed forests
specs.style: Funny, modern lettering on sunrise background

record.description: A humorous Hallmark Shoebox birthday card for a friend or relative who appreciates irreverent, edgy sentiments. It features modern lettering on a sunrise background and comes with a matching envelope.

specs.care: Machine washable (remove insole)

record.description: Comfortable flat shoes for women designed for everyday wear, including driving, walking, and commuting. Features a breathable cotton lining, a cushioned leather insole with arch support, and a lightweight, slip-resistant jelly outsole. The insole can be removed so the shoes can be machine washed.

A lightweight graphic t-shirt with a Switzerland and Swiss Alps theme and a classic fit. Double-needle stitching on the sleeves and hem adds durability. Suited to hiking, travel, or as a souvenir or gift.

specs.use: Insulates heating and AC ducts and pipes

record.description: A foil-backed cotton wrap for insulating heating and air conditioning ducts and pipes. It cushions surfaces, reduces vibration, and needs no gloves, mask, or goggles to install. Carries a Class A fire rating and comes in a 25-foot roll.

An espresso and cappuccino machine with a brushed stainless-steel finish and red accents. It delivers 20 bar of pump pressure and has a steam nozzle for frothing milk. The removable water tank and drip tray make refilling and cleaning simpler.

specs.features: Freestyle rotor, front and rear pegs

record.description: A 20-inch freestyle BMX bike from Dynacraft, built for tricks and street riding. It has a freestyle rotor, front and rear U-brakes, and front and rear pegs for stunts. The 48-spoke wheels and deluxe paint finish add durability and style.

specs.material: High density fiberboard and solid wood veneer

record.description: A walnut jewelry armoire with a lockable top lid, a vanity mirror, and ring rolls. Side doors hold necklaces on double-tiered hooks, and eight pull-out drawers offer varied storage for accessories. Arrives ready to use with no assembly needed.

specs.overall dimensions: 18 ft (L) x 17 ft (D) x 9.5 ft (H) inflated
specs.included: carry bag, repair kit, 5 stakes, 2 hoses (blower not included)

record.description: An inflatable water park with two slides, a climbing wall, a splash pool and a water cannon for hot summer play. Built from puncture-resistant PVC-coated oxford fabric with safety netting, it is ASTM certified and folds down for storage. Designed for up to four children aged roughly 3 to 10. A blower is required and is sold separately.

A wired USB optical mouse with three buttons, a rubber scroll wheel, and 1000 DPI tracking for everyday computer use. It plugs in with no drivers needed and works with Windows and Mac systems. The mouse has a rainbow LED light and a 1.6-meter cord for flexible desk placement.

specs.style: Joan of Arctic Shearling Mid Calf Boot

record.description: A mid-calf winter boot with waterproof suede uppers and a soft shearling cuff. The faux fur lining keeps feet warm, while the seam-sealed construction and vulcanized rubber shell help block wet snow and rain. A felt frost plug in the midsole adds insulation.

Individual classic eyelash extensions for salon use, made from faux mink silk. Offered in a range of lengths and thicknesses, with a CC curl that stays consistent. The metallic film strips leave no paper-backing residue and help shorten application time.

A long sleeve men's t-shirt from Gildan's DryBlend line, sold as a two-pack in sport grey, medium. It has a longer dropped shoulder, a straighter armhole, and wider, shorter sleeves, with a fabric meant to keep you cool by wicking sweat. Neck tape adds reinforcement, and the side seams are designed to stay straight after washing.

A minimizing underwire bra with supportive fabric and a 2-ply back for smoothing and shaping. Wider-set straps and a more open underwire aim to keep support comfortable, and the open neckline offers balanced coverage. Body beige tone.

A folding incline wedge tumbling mat in bright yellow, suited to gymnastics, stretching, yoga, martial arts, and home exercise. Its trapezoidal shape lets several mats stack for storage, and the zippered cover lets you remove and clean the inner pad.

specs.closure: bottom zipper and hook and loop wings

record.description: A wearable swaddle sack for newborns that can be worn with arms in, arms out, or one of each. A bottom zipper allows diaper changes without unwrapping the baby, and adjustable hook-and-loop wings provide a snug, re-fastenable fit that helps block the startle reflex.

A small 14k white gold pendant charm shaped as the number 1, laser cut and etched for a clean, modern look. Its brushed finish and compact size suit everyday wear with a necklace. Hypoallergenic and presented in gift packaging, it is a thoughtful choice for birthdays, anniversaries, or milestones.

A slim, clear protective case for the iPhone X or XS in white. It uses D3O impact-absorbing material and bevelled edges to guard against knocks and drops, while a UV scratch-resistant coating helps keep the case looking clear. Precision cut-outs leave all buttons and ports accessible.

Winter ankle boots for women made from vegan faux leather with a warm, padded lining and faux fur collar. Quilted side panels and a rubber sole give stable footing on slippery or snowy ground, suited to fall and winter outings.
Classic five-pocket men's jeans in a black denim wash with a slim thigh, bootcut leg, and a 17-inch leg opening. A touch of stretch helps them keep their shape and stay comfortable for everyday wear.

specs.strap: Reversible nylon slip-thru, blue and white floral/swirl print

record.description: A women's Timex wristwatch with a round white dial, full Arabic numerals, and 24-hour military time. The polished silver-tone case measures 38mm. The reversible slip-thru nylon strap shows a blue side and a floral-swirl print side. An Indiglo backlight aids reading in the dark. Water resistant to 30 meters for splashes, not swimming.

specs.features: Cargo pockets, scissors pocket, D-ring at left leg

record.description: Women's low-rise cargo scrub pants in black, built for comfortable all-day wear. A drawstring waist adjusts the fit, while multiple pockets, including one sized for scissors, keep tools close. A D-ring on the left leg and adjustable ankle toggles add practical touches.

A one-piece swimsuit for little girls, designed for water play, pool days, beach outings and photos. Made from a stretchy polyamide-elastane blend with a smooth feel, it dries fairly quickly and allows free movement. Its printed pattern adds a playful look. Hand washing in cool water and drying flat in shade are recommended.

A lightweight Marvel T-shirt featuring Miles Morales from the Spider-Man: Spiderverse films, cut in a classic fit. Officially licensed apparel with double-needle stitching along the sleeves and bottom hem for durability.

specs.washability: Washes out with shampoo and water
specs.use: Costume, party, DIY, dog hair coloring

record.description: A set of ten bright temporary hair chalks paired with a comb for quick, non-permanent color changes. Blend shades for custom looks, and rinse out with regular shampoo. Works best on light hair; darker hair may need a little water first. Suited to parties, cosplay, and gifts for kids and teens.

A three-pair pack of women's no-show liners with a breathable mesh top and a cushioned, ventilated sole. A silicone grip on the heel helps keep them in place, and the soft construction is designed for everyday comfort inside low-cut shoes.

A 5.2 channel home theater receiver with 4K Ultra HD video pass-through supporting HDR and BT.2020, plus built-in Bluetooth and USB for wireless music. Works with Denon HEOS Link to build a multi-room audio system. Includes an on-screen setup assistant and four quick-select buttons for saved audio settings.

A foldable vocal recording booth with dense egg crate foam lining the interior to absorb echoes and reflections. Holes allow audio cables and a mic stand to pass through. Suitable for vocal recording, podcasting, and voice-over work, and it packs flat for travel.

specs.material: 100% cotton washed canvas front, 100% polyester mesh back
specs.sweatband: Carhartt Force sweatband with FastDry technology

record.description: A structured, medium-profile cap with a pre-curved sandwich visor. The front is washed cotton canvas and the back is breathable polyester mesh. A Carhartt Force sweatband helps resist odor and wick moisture, and a Carhartt patch sits on the front.

A compact laser projector from Epson that casts a bright image up to 150 inches, including in rooms with the lights on. Built-in Android TV with a remote and voice search gives access to streaming apps, and an internal speaker handles sound. Available in black with copper accents.

A retro tennis-style sneaker for women with a leather upper, traditional lacing for a secure fit, and a contrasting Swoosh design along the side. The rubber outsole offers traction, and the fabric-lined footbed is built for everyday comfort.

specs.compartments: Double layer with elastic loops, mesh pockets, and tablet pocket

record.description: A zippered nylon organizer bag for keeping cables, chargers, memory cards, and small electronic accessories in order while traveling. Two layers offer elastic loops, mesh pockets, and a padded sleeve sized for a mini tablet. The water-resistant exterior and detachable hand strap make it easy to carry.

specs.water_resistance: UA Storm technology, highly water-resistant finish

record.description: A women's tote from Under Armour with a highly water-resistant finish from UA Storm technology. It has a large main compartment, an oversized wordmark zipper pull, and double webbing straps for carrying in more than one way. Holds about 25 liters.

A modern take on the 1980s Nike Air Mariah, this running shoe pairs a lightweight Flyknit upper with a snug, sock-like fit. Zoom Air cushioning supports each stride, a heel pull tab makes them easy to put on, and a durable rubber outsole provides traction.

specs.included: Hook & loop roll, push pins, instruction manual

record.description: A magnetic door screen that hangs across a standard doorway to let fresh air and sunlight in while keeping insects out. Made from thickened fiberglass mesh with reinforced edges, it closes with magnets and hook-and-loop strips to resist wind. Includes installation hardware.

specs.material: Shaggy plush with sponge layer and anti-slip dots
specs.use: Living room, bedroom, kids room, nursery

record.description: A soft, fluffy shag area rug in teal blue measuring 5 by 8 feet. Its thick plush pile feels comfortable underfoot, and a dense sponge layer helps absorb sound. Anti-slip dots on the underside help hold it in place on hard floors. Suited to bedrooms, living rooms, and children's rooms.

specs.fit: Regular fit, straight cut at waist
specs.care: Machine or hand wash cold, do not bleach

record.description: A long sleeve henley-style popover shirt with a mandarin collar and chest buttons. Made from a cotton-polyester oxford blend that is slightly thick, opaque, and holds its shape through repeated washing. Suited to spring, cool summer days, and fall, and to costume, beach, or everyday wear.

specs.putting surface: approx. 2 ft x 8.5 ft inside border
specs.use: indoor or outdoor

record.description: A large practice putting mat designed to give a realistic feel of a real putting green. Its premium turf surface suits indoor or outdoor practice, and a padded rubber base adds comfort and stability. Two holes with flags are included for setting up putting drills at home or on the course.

A manual focus prime lens with a 35mm focal length and a bright F1.2 maximum aperture for low-light and shallow depth-of-field shooting. Designed for compact Canon EOS-M mirrorless cameras, it has a crescent-shaped focus ring and a multi-layer coated optical system.

specs.light modes: Flicker and steady glow, adjustable brightness

record.description: A set of two battery-operated flameless candles with a moving flame effect and a waterproof design for indoor or outdoor use. Each frosted ivory candle is controlled by remote, offers flicker or steady glow with adjustable brightness, and can be set on a 2, 4, 6, or 8 hour timer. No wax, smoke, or open flame.

specs.type: Functional thermal underwear base layer set

record.description: A men's thermal base layer set with a long sleeve shirt or long johns, designed for cold-weather activity. The double-seamless build and elastic zones aim to allow free movement, while the fabric is meant to retain warmth, wick moisture and breathe. Suited to mountaineering, cycling, skiing, hiking and training.

specs.included: 1 x USB to DC charging cable

record.description: A replacement USB charging cable with a 2.0mm DC tip for Mini S530 wireless Bluetooth earbuds and headphones. The 30cm cable can charge from a wall adapter, laptop USB port, power bank, or car charger. Measure the plug before ordering, as it is not compatible with every headset.

A fabric storage box for kids and toddlers that fits most cube shelving units. Its 13-inch cube shape keeps toys and essentials tidy, and a front tab makes it easy for children and adults to pull out. A felt animal appliqué on the front adds a playful touch.

A grey double-deck lunch bag with a wide mouth for easy packing. Its two layers keep different foods apart, and the thickened, seamless PEVA liner resists leaks and wipes clean. The insulated lining holds food warm or cold, and ice cubes can be added to keep contents chilled. Suitable for lunches, picnics, or everyday carrying.

A set of four stoneware rice bowls from Denby's Heritage Terrace line, each handcrafted by skilled artisans. Suitable for oven, microwave, freezer, and dishwasher use, these bowls work well for everyday serving of rice, soups, and side dishes.

specs.use: Block scratcher, floor scratcher, and lounger

record.description: A corrugated cardboard scratcher shaped as a chaise, giving cats a textured surface to scratch and a cradle-like spot to lounge. Catnip is layered between the corrugate so its scent is released as cats scratch. Made in the USA.
A sleeveless midi dress in navy lace with a fitted bodice and flared skirt. Partially lined for comfort and coverage. Contemporary cut that runs small, so consider sizing up if between sizes.

A gentle bath and shower gel from L'Occitane with a delicate Cherry Blossom fragrance. It cleanses the skin while leaving a light floral scent. Works up into a lather on wet skin and rinses clean for a fragranced shower experience.

specs.package dimensions: 3.12 in L x 3.12 in W x 5.06 in H

record.description: A replacement oil filter for vehicle engines, sold under the WIX brand with model number 57502XP. The package is compact and weighs about three-quarters of a pound. Manufactured in China.

specs.features: Waterproof, sand-resistant, quick-drying, 4 pockets, 4 ground stakes

record.description: A large, lightweight outdoor blanket that fits four to eight adults for beaches, picnics, camping, and hiking. Its nylon surface sheds sand and dries quickly, and built-in pockets hold small essentials. Four stakes help keep it in place in breezy conditions. Folds compactly into its carry bag.

A versatile lace-up boat shoe for kids that works as a casual sneaker or a dressier option. Its leather-like upper and cushioned memory foam footbed offer comfort, while the rubber outsole provides traction and the lacing system helps keep a snug fit.

specs.style: Classic Short Rubber Logo Fashion Boot

record.description: A women's short fashion boot with a soft suede upper and a cozy UGGpure lining and insole for comfortable all-day wear. It features a Treadlite outsole and a rubber UGG logo print on the front shaft. Available in black, size 8 M US.

specs.size: Neck width 12 in, bottom width 22 in, height 29 in
specs.straps: Adjustable poly-webbing neck and waist ties

record.description: A pink waterproof apron made of smooth, glossy vinyl that wipes clean easily. Lightweight for long shifts, with adjustable neck straps and long waist ties. Suited to cooking, food prep, gardening, garage work and other messy tasks.

A full motion wall bracket for flat and curved TVs and monitors from 13 to 30 inches, supporting up to 33 pounds. It tilts, swivels, and rotates for comfortable viewing, and its arm extends about 14 inches from the wall and folds flat to save space. Steel construction and lag screws are included for secure mounting.

A three-tier fan-shaped corner shelf made from lightweight paulownia wood with a torched dark brown finish. Hangs from a nail, screw, or hook with an adjustable jute rope, and works in entryways, kitchens, bedrooms, and living spaces for displaying small decor and collectibles.

A set of coordinating cotton dresses for baby girls aged 12 to 18 months. Made from 100% cotton, the soft fabric is gentle on delicate skin. Suited to everyday wear, this value pack offers comfortable dresses at an affordable price.

specs.features: Wet-Lock gel, rapid-drying top layer

record.description: Absorbent training pads for dogs that use a built-in attractant to draw pets to the pad and reduce accidents. The odor control formula, enhanced with Febreze freshness, neutralizes ammonia smells, and a rapid-drying top layer helps prevent tracking. A pack of 50 pads sized for dogs of all sizes.

specs.materials: ABS plastic mount, stainless steel rod

record.description: A space-saving folding rack that mounts on a wall to dry laundry or hang clothes. It folds flat when not in use and works on drywall, brick, concrete, or wood with the included anchors and screws. Useful in laundry rooms, closets, and bedrooms.

specs.lettering: Black 2 inch x 12 inch OVERSIZE LOAD letters

record.description: A yellow mesh nylon banner marked OVERSIZE LOAD in large black letters, for alerting passing traffic when hauling wide or large loads. Brass grommets allow quick attachment to the front or back of a vehicle. Meets DOT signage requirements in most states.

Floating golf practice balls for water use around pools, ponds, and driving ranges. Each two-piece ball has a durable injection-molded Surlyn cover with 432 dimples. Comes in a set of 48 neon green balls with a carry bag for transport.

specs.connection: Universal faucet adapter and quick connect

record.description: A compact countertop dishwasher suited to apartments, offices, and small kitchens. It offers six wash cycles, a delay start of up to eight hours, and an LED display showing remaining time. A universal faucet adapter provides quick connection to most kitchen faucets.

specs.includes: bain-marie, decorating stands, baking and decorating gadgets

record.description: A kids' cake pop kit that lets children make Butterfinger-style treats at home without an oven. It comes with a bain-marie, decorating stands, and other baking and decorating tools, plus a printed recipes booklet. Food ingredients are not included. Recommended for ages 6 and up.

A swivel faucet aerator that rotates 720 degrees so water can reach every corner of a sink without soaking you. It offers two flow modes, from a soft stream for hands and face to a stronger spray for quick rinsing of produce. Made of solid brass with a polished electroplated finish, it fits most round faucets and installs in seconds.

Men's golf shoes from adidas in a grey, green and black colorway. They have a regular fit, a lace closure, and a mesh and synthetic upper. Bounce midsole with Boost in the heel adds cushioning, and the upper includes at least 50% recycled material.
A men's Outback-style straw hat from Stetson in a natural tone. It has a vented crown for airflow and comes in an XL size, suited to sun protection in warm weather.

specs.use: Bathroom vanity storage for cotton swabs, cotton balls, and rounds

record.description: A two-piece clear canister set for organizing bathroom vanity items such as cotton swabs, cotton balls, cotton rounds, and bath salts. Each jar has a wide mouth and a removable lid for easy access and cleaning. The plastic resembles glass while being shatter-resistant.

specs.included: 1 hybrid case, 1 tempered glass screen protector
specs.features: Shockproof, card holder slot, swivel belt clip

record.description: A rose gold protective cover for the Samsung Galaxy On5, with a two-layer design pairing a rubberized interior with a hardened outer shell for shock absorption. Includes a card slot, a kickstand, and a tempered glass screen protector. Phone not included.

specs.use areas: Upper and lower lips, cheeks, chin

record.description: A portable electric facial hair remover for women that uses dual stainless steel blades to trim fine and coarse hair on the face without pain. Designed as a mini face shaver for lips, cheeks and chin, it is gentle on all skin types. A spare replacement head is included for longer use.

specs.strap length: 9.8 ft (3 m) with 18 loops per strap
specs.included: 2 carabiner clips, tree straps, storage bag

record.description: A seamless double-layer camping hammock with a different color on each face, black or orange. Large enough for two adults, it carries up to 880 lbs. Adjustable webbing tree straps suit many trunk sizes, and the included carabiners and bag make setup and packing quick. Lightweight enough to hang from a backpack for hiking or travel.
A hooded reindeer costume for dogs, well suited to Christmas or any winter-themed party. Velcro fastenings at the neck and chest make it quick to put on and take off.

A height-adjustable standing desk with a 47 by 30 inch wooden top on a sturdy metal frame. Dual motors raise and lower it between 29 and 49 inches, and the top tilts from 13 to 45 degrees. An LED touch panel offers memory presets, a child lock, and two USB charging ports for devices at your workstation.

specs.pieces: 5 pirates, 2-piece cannon, treasure chest, eye patch, X marks the spot flag

record.description: A ten-piece pirate play set with five buccaneer figures, a two-piece cannon, a treasure chest, an eye patch, and an X marks the spot flag. Hand-painted figures suit imaginative play, party favors, cake toppers, and school projects. Recommended for ages 3 and up and easy to wipe clean with soap and water.

specs.cushioning: Gel pads in heel and forefoot

record.description: Trim-to-fit orthotic insoles for men's casual and athletic shoes, sized for men's 9 to 10.5. The contoured neutral arch suits most foot types, while lightweight gel pads in the heel and forefoot add comfort without bulk. A moisture-wicking treatment helps keep feet dry and manages temperature.

A mid-century modern accent armchair with a curved back, cut-out silhouette, and gentle recline. Upholstered in soft polyester with subtle piped trim, it rests on dark walnut-stained wood legs with non-marking caps. Dense foam padding gives a supportive seat, suited to living rooms, bedrooms, offices, or entryways.

specs.features: BPA free, vacuum tight seal, locked clips

record.description: A two-tier round stainless steel lunch container with a white twist-open lid. Its vacuum-tight seal and locking clips help keep food from leaking or spilling, and it suits soup and hot food. The container is BPA free and can go in the dishwasher or freezer.

Women's knit Bermuda pajama shorts with a relaxed fit and comfortable elastic waistband. Finished in a chambray blue colorway with a printed pattern drawn by a design team, these lounge shorts suit sleepwear and relaxed days at home.

specs.accessories: Hands, head, backpack, holographic wings, 2 weapons

record.description: A fully articulated 6-inch collectible action figure of Falcon from the Avengers: Infinity War film. Detachable wing gears let the figure convert into a flying pose. Comes with multiple interchangeable hands, an alternate head, holographic wings, and two accessory weapons. Recommended for ages 15 and up.

specs.part: Radiator grill front bumper mesh decal sticker

record.description: A red radiator grille mesh decal sticker designed to fit the front bumper of a 2018 Kia Stinger. Its 3D-printed design is meant to give a sporty, tuned look. It attaches to the grille with double-sided adhesive tape and comes as a single set.

A stylized vinyl collectible figure of Thor from the movie Avengers: Endgame, made by Funko. Standing about 3 and three-quarter inches tall, it suits display on a shelf or desk. It is part of a series, so fans can collect the other Avengers Endgame figures as well.

specs.theme: My Hero Academia / Boku No Hero Academia
specs.fit: Standard US size, adults and kids

record.description: Anime-themed training sweatpants inspired by My Hero Academia characters such as Izuku and Tsuyu Asui. Made from soft cotton, they suit cosplay, Halloween, theme parties, or everyday casual wear. A fun gift for anime fans.

specs.frame: Steel arms, 8 ribs, rust-free powder coated

record.description: A 9-foot outdoor market umbrella with a round beige polyester canopy that repels water and resists fading. Eight steel ribs on a powder-coated frame support the canopy, and a crank lifts it open. Push-button tilt angles the shade away from the sun. A wind vent eases pressure in gusts. Base not included.

A hands-on kit that lets children grow their own flowers from seed. Kids decorate a tin planter with paints they can mix into new shades, then plant zinnia, marigold, and cosmo seeds. Included stake holders help keep each planting spot organized, and easy instructions explain how the flowers grow.

Men's hiking shoe from Merrell in a walnut colorway, built with a suede and mesh upper for support and airflow. A bellows tongue helps keep moisture and debris out, and a rubber toe cap adds protection on the trail. Set on a Vibram TC5-plus sole with 5mm lugs for grip.

specs.handle: Retractable telescoping trolley handle, extends 41 inches

record.description: Navy hardside carry-on suitcase with multi-directional spinner wheels for smooth rolling. The ABS shell has molded corner guards, and the tear-resistant lining protects the interior. Zippered organizer pockets and a garment restraint help keep clothes in place. Top, bottom, and side grab handles make lifting easy.

specs.care: Hand wash cold, do not bleach, hang or line dry

record.description: A lightweight, classic draped open-front blazer in red, designed for everyday wear. Its soft, stretchy rayon fabric is slip-on comfortable and suits office, casual, or evening occasions. Hand wash cold and hang or line dry.

specs.included: 75 sticks (14.96 in), 23 blue balls and 22 green balls (1.97 in diameter)

record.description: A 120-piece construction kit for building forts, tents, castles, tunnels and towers indoors or outdoors. Plastic rods snap into colorful ball connectors and stay firmly joined, so structures hold together. Designed for children to build and plan together, it encourages teamwork and imaginative play. A storage bag keeps the pieces portable. A blanket is not included.

specs.material: Memory Foam, Silica Gel, Rutilated Quartz Nano heating elements

record.description: Rechargeable heated insoles with memory foam cushioning and arch support for men and women. Three adjustable temperature settings and a power display help you manage battery life. Trim the front to fit your toes in the heating area. Breathable, washable, and designed to keep feet warm in cold weather.

Aviator-style women's sunglasses with a gold-tone metal frame and lightweight, adjustable nose pads. The impact-resistant polycarbonate lenses carry a coating that blocks UV rays, including on cloudy days. A soft microfiber pouch is included for storage and cleaning.

specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: Compression pants for football, soccer, running, yoga and other sports in any weather. Smooth, ultra-soft polyester-spandex fabric stays light and breathable, keeps you cool in summer and warm in winter, and offers UPF 30 sun protection. Fits snugly; choose a larger size for a looser feel.

A heavyweight men's car coat in a black wool blend twill with a soft, cozy feel that keeps you warm in cold weather. It has a roomy cut through the chest and waist and a button-front closure. A practical everyday outerwear piece from Amazon Essentials.
A set of twelve large silver metallic foil bows for decorating gifts. Each bow is about 4.5 inches across and has a self-adhesive back for quick, easy application to packages.

specs.charging: Dual USB: QC 3.0 port and 2.4A port
specs.display: LED backlit screen, 7 ambient light colors

record.description: A compact Bluetooth FM transmitter and car charger that streams music from your phone, USB drive, or TF card. It supports hands-free calls with a built-in microphone and voice assistants, and includes a fast-charging USB port alongside a second charging port. An illuminated display and colorful backlight add a lively touch to your car's interior.

specs.compatibility: Fits most standard 32 oz jelly jars

record.description: A red wild bird feeder designed to hold 32 ounces of oriole jelly. The inverted bottle design keeps jelly fresh, clean and dry, while an internal stirrer dispenses a measured amount. The bottle can be swapped with most standard 32 oz jelly jars and is simple to clean.

specs.care: Machine wash warm on gentle, non-chlorine bleach, tumble dry low

record.description: A king-size bedding set from Sferra's Grande Hotel Collection, woven in Italy from 100% Egyptian cotton percale. Crisp 200 thread count sheets in white, with colored satin stitching on the flat sheet and pillowcases. Includes a flat sheet, fitted sheet, and two pillowcases.

A set of ten white festoon LED bulbs sized at 42mm for replacing interior lamps such as dome, map, and trunk or cargo area lights. Each bulb uses sixteen 3528 SMD chips and installs by simple plug-in fitment. Rated for long service life, and the bulb works either way round if reversed.

A gray marine boat seat from Millennium Marine, model SW-200, sized 18 by 21 by 6 inches. It mounts to most boat pedestals, supports up to 400 pounds, and weighs 8 pounds. Backed by a 3-year warranty.

A deep, cool fuschia hair dye that works as a darkest pink shade. It is ready to use without developer, can be mixed with other formulas for custom tones, and gradually fades over several weeks. The vegan, ammonia-free formula is free of parabens, gluten, and resorcinol.

specs.features: Waterproof, shock-absorbing cushioning, rubber lug outsole

record.description: A mid-height ankle boot built for hiking and outdoor trails. Leather upper with waterproof protection, cushioned footbed for shock absorption, and rubber lug outsole for grip on varied terrain. Rugged, outdoor-inspired styling.

A structured Under Armour cap in Academy Blue with red accents, built with a pre-curved visor and a low-profile classic fit. The foam-padded front panel adds comfort, and the Microthread fabric is designed to dry quickly and stay light against the skin.

A compact 0.7 cubic foot microwave oven in red from Daewoo, model KOR07R3ZER. It comes with a turntable to help heat food more evenly and suits small kitchens, offices, or dorm rooms for everyday reheating and cooking.

specs.suitable for: Bridal, bridesmaids, flower girls, festivals, photography

record.description: A handmade royal blue flower crown headband designed to be worn as a hair wreath. Its roughly 19 cm diameter suits most head sizes. Well suited to weddings, festivals, and photo sessions, it adds a charming, eye-catching touch for brides, bridesmaids, and flower girls.

specs.features: Cup holder, headphone hook, cable management tray, two speaker/CD holders
specs.frame: Built-in metal frame with Z-shaped legs
specs.stability: Extra suction cup on feet; waterproof and non-slip

record.description: A large Z-shaped gaming desk with a carbon fiber surface and a curved top meant to relax the arms while leaning forward. It includes a cup holder, headphone hook, speaker holders, and a cable tray under the back edge. A metal frame and suction-cup feet aim to keep it steady on the floor.

A professional-grade extra long curling iron and wand with a 1 inch barrel and a gold finish. It reaches temperatures up to 430 degrees and includes a rotating cool tip and adjustable rheostat heat control. A heat-resistant mat is included to protect countertops during use.

specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: Mad Grip F50 Thunderdome impact gloves in high-visibility orange, size large. Breathable knit construction with grip injection coating and reinforced high-wear zones to help absorb vibration. Suitable for handling both large and small parts, and machine washable.

specs.suspension: Front telescopic forks, rear mono shock

record.description: A 50cc gas dirt bike built for kids learning to ride off-road. It has a fully automatic throttle-and-go setup, a pull start, and a restrictable throttle for speed control. The chromoly frame, telescopic front forks, and rear mono shock suit rough trails, and the outdoor tires grip in wet or dry conditions.

A protective battery case for iPhone 6, 6s, 7 and 8 with a 6000 mAh built-in battery to extend phone use on the go. Charge the case with your original Apple cable, then press and hold the power button to start or stop charging your phone. Supports earphones and wireless Bluetooth headphones. Does not protect the screen.

specs.material: Polycarbonate hard shell with TPU inner layer
specs.cutouts: Large cut-out for buttons, ports, camera

record.description: A rose gold glitter protective case for the iPhone XR. Its three-layer design pairs a hard outer shell with a soft clear inner layer to absorb drops and shocks. Raised edges help shield the screen and camera lens, and openings leave buttons, ports, and speakers accessible.

specs.closure: Magnetic flip with zipper coin pocket
specs.features: Detachable wrist strap, kickstand

record.description: A purple folio wallet case built for the Samsung Galaxy S20 5G. It holds nine cards plus cash and coins, and a detachable hand strap helps keep the phone secure. A folding kickstand supports hands-free viewing, and a magnetic clasp keeps the contents closed.

specs.securing: Tuck under water tubes or reinforced tie-down loops

record.description: A black knitted polyethylene net that lays over a rectangular pool winter cover to catch falling leaves before they decay in the pool. Lift it off once the trees are bare to clear debris in one step. Tie-down loops and tuck-under edges help keep it in place.

specs.floor use: Hardwood, parquet, laminate, linoleum, tile, carpet

record.description: A set of five blue polyurethane replacement casters for office chairs, fitting standard 7/16 inch stems. They roll quietly and smoothly over cables and are designed to protect hardwood, tile, and carpet floors without a chair mat. Heavy-duty ABEC9 bearings support steady movement.

A refurbished Apple iPhone 8 with 64GB of storage in Space Gray. This US version is locked to AT&T and works only with compatible carriers. Battery health was tested and guaranteed to be at least 80%. Includes a generic MFi certified charger and cable; no headphones or SIM card.

specs.size: One size fits most teens and adults

record.description: A floppy-brimmed oversized bonnet designed as a costume accessory. Its wide brim adds an instant Americana look to themed outfits. One size fits most teens and adults, and it comes in white.

A gray metal-frame sewing machine offering 32 built-in stitches, including a one-step buttonhole, for garments, crafts, and home decor. It features a built-in needle threader, a stronger motor for heavyweight fabric, and heavy-duty accessories such as a walking foot and non-stick foot.

specs.features: Seamless toe closure, arch support, reinforced heel and toe

record.description: Men's Chewbacca crew socks from Stance in a green colorway, size Large. Built with a seamless toe closure for comfort, arch support for a snug fit, and reinforced heel and toe areas for added durability.

specs.item: Color changing gel nail polish set
specs.wear: Up to 2+ weeks with proper application

record.description: A six-bottle set of temperature-responsive gel nail polish that shifts color with the warmth of your nails. Designed for LED lamp curing, it offers a glossy, long-lasting finish. Works best with the brand's base and top coats and an application temperature of about 20-25 degrees. Comes in a gift box.

specs.included: 4 ratchet buckles, 4 hook straps, 4 loop straps, mesh bag

record.description: A four-piece set of red ratchet tie-down straps, each 10 feet long and 1 inch wide, for securing loads on canoes, kayaks, motorcycles, bikes, boats and similar cargo. Rated to 900 lb break strength with a 300 lb working load per strap. PVC-coated S-hooks help protect cargo and vehicles from scratches. Comes with a mesh bag for storage.

A set of three double-walled glass espresso cups that keep hot drinks warm and cold drinks cool. Suited to espresso, cappuccino, macchiato, and tea, as well as iced drinks and ice cream. Their modern look makes them a fitting choice for cafes, restaurants, and home use, or as a gift.

specs.design: Slim full-body case with 1mm raised bezel

record.description: A slim forest green silicone case for iPhone X and iPhone XS. Its soft liquid silicone wraps the back and edges, with a microfiber lining inside and raised bezels that guard the screen and camera. It leaves buttons accessible, works with wireless charging, and wipes clean easily.

specs.fits: 22 oz long neck or tall bottles; reported to fit 16-24 oz bottles

record.description: A neoprene drawstring sleeve that keeps a water bottle or tall beer bottle cold while you ride, hike, climb, or travel. It includes a shoulder strap and a plastic clip so you can carry it or hook it onto a belt or backpack.

A set of 100 individually sealed 1 ml plastic syringes, each fitted with a cap to keep the tip clean and prevent leaks. Clear scale marks support accurate measuring and dispensing of small liquid amounts. Suited to essential oils, perfumes, lab work, garden watering, and dosing liquid medication for small pets. Needles are not included.

A slim protective case for iPhone 7, iPhone 8, and iPhone SE 2020 with a marble-style design. Its flexible TPU shell helps guard against bumps and scratches, while a rotating ring kickstand lets you prop up the phone at any angle for watching videos. Cutouts keep cameras, speaker, ports, and buttons fully accessible.

specs.material: Metal frame legs, MDF with rustic wood grain finish
specs.assembly: About 20 minutes, tools and instructions included

record.description: A large industrial-style computer desk with a rustic wood grain top, sized to hold monitors, a laptop, and writing supplies. Metal X-shaped legs, a rear support mesh, and adjustable feet aim to keep it steady. Suited to home offices, lofts, and farmhouse-style spaces, and quick to assemble.

specs.finish: Brushed matte outer surface, high polish inner face

record.description: A men's wedding band from King Will in tungsten carbide, with an 8mm width and a two-tone black and silver finish. The outer surface has a brushed matte look while the inner face is highly polished for comfort. Hypoallergenic and scratch resistant, it arrives in a storage box and is backed by a lifetime warranty.

specs.spray_functions: Two (rainshower, concentrated rinse) plus combination spray

record.description: A large 8.5-inch rainshower showerhead in a mirror-like chrome finish that suits most bathroom styles. Its self-pressurizing spray is designed to deliver fuller water coverage, and it offers a full rainshower, a concentrated rinse, and a combination spray setting.

specs.care: Machine wash cold; tumble dry low

record.description: A pair of dual-function pocket mitts made from 100% cotton terry cloth. Slip your hands into the pockets to handle hot cookware, or set hot dishes on them as pot holders to protect counters. Machine washable for easy care.

specs.product type: Bunion corrector splint with toe separator
specs.material: Elastic fabric with medical-grade gel separator

record.description: A beige orthopedic splint designed to be worn on the foot to help ease bunion discomfort and hold the big toe gently in alignment over time. Its breathable elastic fabric and gel toe separator are reusable and easy to clean. An elastic heel loop helps keep it in place during sleep. Fits most US feet sizes 6 to 11.

specs.part type: Front bumper license plate mounting bracket

record.description: A black thermoplastic bracket for mounting a front license plate to the bumper of select 2006-2008 Ford F-150 and Lincoln Mark LT trucks. Made from heavy-duty automotive grade material, it comes with the screws needed for installation and is designed to fit directly.

specs.key ingredients: Vitamin C, witch hazel, MSM, vitamin E, glycolic acid

record.description: A mist-style facial toner that cleanses and preps skin before serums and moisturizers. Formulated with vitamin C and witch hazel to help control excess oil, even skin tone, and support a brighter, smoother look. Suitable for dry, sensitive, and combination skin.

A vintage-wood L-shaped corner desk with a large work surface suited to multiple monitors. Its X crossbar frame and adjustable leg pads aim to keep it steady on uneven floors. Includes an iron hook for hanging bags or headphones and a CPU stand. Suits home offices, gaming setups, and dorm rooms.

specs.features: Multifunctional SIM tool and bottle opener

record.description: A compact key organizer made of carbon fiber to keep up to 20 keys together and quiet in a pocket, purse, or running belt. It is lightweight, sturdy, and includes a SIM tool and bottle opener. Assembly instructions are available in a video tutorial.

A compact odor-blocking pouch with a carbon-lined interior and airtight closure meant to keep smells from escaping. Sized to carry essentials in a backpack or by hand, it includes a wrist strap for easy carrying.

A twin-size weighted blanket filled with glass beads, designed to rest over the top of a bed and provide gentle, even pressure that may help adults and teens settle to sleep. Made of cotton with a seven-layer construction to keep the beads contained. Machine wash gently in cold water or spot clean; hang or flat dry.

specs.care: Dry wash or hand wash, hang to dry

record.description: A pair of baby blue decorative pillow covers with a shimmering sequin side and a soft satin reverse. Sized for 18 by 18 inch inserts, they suit weddings, holidays, and everyday decor. The hidden zipper keeps the finish tidy, and the covers can be hand washed and hung to dry.

A pear-shaped teardrop ring set featuring sparkling cubic zirconia stones in a classic design. Suited to bridal, bridesmaid, engagement, and everyday or formal occasions. Arrives with a gift box and favor bag, making it a ready gift for a loved one.

A sturdy stainless steel baking rack sized for most standard ovens and sheet pans. Its evenly spaced grid supports cookies and other foods while allowing air to circulate for cooling or elevating food above grease. The rack is designed to resist warping and can be cleaned in the dishwasher.

specs.use: Tattoo ink for all art types

record.description: Pigmented tattoo ink in a 1 oz bottle, offered in a black shade. Formulated to heal true and retain vibrant color. Made in the USA and suited to all styles of tattoo work.

A replacement adjustable shoulder strap for cross body bags, purses, and handbags. Made from soft brown synthetic PU leather with metal snap hooks, it adjusts from about 43 to 49 inches to suit different wearers and bag styles.

A nighttime sleep aid in tablet form containing doxylamine succinate, packaged as one 80-count bottle with one tablet per dose. Intended to help users fall asleep and stay asleep through the night. Marketed as non-habit forming when used as directed.

A set of six shatterproof stemless champagne flutes holding 12 oz each. Made from BPA-free Tritan plastic, they look like glass while resisting breaks, and they are safe to run through the dishwasher. Suited to mimosas, prosecco, and parties with children.

specs.package: 1 afro puff with headwrap, 1 eyelash, 1 hairpin

record.description: A short, curly synthetic wig with a headband attached, so it fits on in seconds by tying up your own hair and tightening the drawstring. The dark red afro puff style suits work, travel, parties, and everyday wear. Elastic cloth fits head circumferences from about 21.5 to 25 inches. Hand washing with mild products and gentle combing is recommended.

A 100-inch matte PVC projector screen with a 16:9 format for movies, presentations, and meetings. It resists wrinkles, is easy to wipe clean, and has a 1.1 gain for clear, less reflective images. The bottom-roll design sets up quickly, and the tripod stand packs into the included carry bag. Suitable for indoor or outdoor use.
A 10-inch French whisk made from 18/8 stainless steel wires, suited to fitting into bowls and saucepans. It is NSF approved, made in the USA, and dishwasher safe for easy cleaning in the kitchen.

A blue lion head vinyl decal sticker with a "Born to be a King" theme. The vinyl is designed to peel off cleanly without leaving damage or residue. Measures about 3.7 by 5 inches and comes with installation instructions.

A two-story playset themed on Keia's treehouse from the Disney Junior Puppy Dog Pals series. Kids can operate the elevator, bounce on the chair, spin the lookout, and use the flower shower with the included 3-inch Keia figure and accessories. Suited to children ages 3 and up.

Binder pages with poly sleeves that hold CDs and DVDs, four discs per page, two on each side. The non-woven liner helps guard discs against scratches, fingerprints, and smudges. Pages fit standard 3 ring binders and come in a pack of 25.

A commercial-style drip coffee brewer from Bunn, designed for steady brewing at 120V and 60 Hz single-phase power. Compact footprint suited to offices, cafes, and break rooms that need reliable batch coffee.

specs.material: Shell: 100% Polyester; Lining: 100% Polyester; Insulation: 100% Polyester
specs.closure: YKK zipper with double metal button

record.description: Men's insulated snow pants for skiing and snowboarding. Water-repellent, windproof and breathable, with taped seams and a diamond-quilted insulated lining. Includes zippered and hook-and-loop pockets, adjustable waist, and boot gaiters with grippers to keep snow out.

specs.packaging: Individual box with photo on front

record.description: A hand-painted miniature sloth figurine perched on a tree, from Jim Shore's Heartwood Creek collection. Crafted from stone resin, it reflects the folk-art style and nostalgic motifs the designer is known for. Arrives in an individual photo box, making it a ready gift or collectible for a display shelf.

Wired craft ribbon with a traditional fall plaid pattern in orange, green, and red, with metallic gold stripe accents. The monofilament wire along the edges helps shape loops and bows that hold their form. Suited to gift wrapping, floral arrangements, wreaths, and seasonal decor.

specs.fit: Classic fit with extra room in shoulders, chest, and body
specs.closure: Button down front, cuffs, and collar

record.description: A men's long sleeve plaid shirt with a relaxed classic fit that offers extra room through the shoulders, chest, and body. Features extra long sleeves and tails, button closures at the front, cuffs, and collar, and a single open pocket on the chest.

A five-string electric bass guitar from Ibanez in a brown finish. It has a maple neck, a spalted maple top over a mahogany body, and a rosewood fretboard with white dot inlays. Medium frets and a B15 bridge complete the build for right-handed players.

A daily body wash with soothing oat that cleanses away dirt, oil, and bacteria while helping protect the skin's natural moisture barrier. Suited to dry, itchy, or sensitive skin, it leaves skin feeling moisturized and soft. Allergy-tested and free of soap and dye.

A loose-fitting zip-up footed romper for babies, designed for both playtime and bedtime. Made from breathable organic cotton that suits sensitive skin, with a diagonal zip for easy diaper changes and non-slip grips on the feet for stability.

A compact 18W USB-C wall charger from AUKEY with a foldable plug, designed for fast charging iPhone 12 series and other devices rated for 30W or less. Lightweight and easy to carry for home, office, or travel. Built-in safeguards help guard against excess current, overheating, and overcharging.

specs.size: Large stand 4.5 in tall, two taper stands 4 in tall
specs.design: Sculpted double heart with rhinestone accents

record.description: A set of three nickel-plated candle stands with sculpted double heart designs and rhinestone accents. Suited to unity candle lighting or romantic wedding decor, the large stand holds a 3-inch pillar candle while the two taper stands complete the set.

A men's slip-on driving-style loafer from Lacoste in black leather. Its flexible moccasin construction supports easy movement, and a cushioned foam insole adds comfort and shock absorption. It features a embossed crocodile logo, a signature Lacoste detail.

specs.material: Linen fabric, sponge, steel pipe bracket, solid wood legs

record.description: A 2-seat convertible loveseat with foldable armrests that unfold into a sleeper bed. The backrest adjusts across five angles for lounging or sitting. Upholstered in breathable linen-blend cover that can be removed for cleaning, with solid wood legs. Suited to small spaces such as apartments, studios, and offices. Quick assembly.

specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: A men's graphic t-shirt from Riot Society featuring a geisha and flower garden design in burgundy. Made from 100% cotton with a soft-wash feel, it is machine washable and has a tagless neck label for comfort.

specs.wings: Detachable, soft fabric with self-stick tabs
specs.features: Glitter accents, elastic arm cuffs, padded waist, knees, and leg cuffs

record.description: A Buzz Lightyear Halloween costume for toddlers, featuring a full bodysuit with detachable soft wings, gloves, and a hat. Easy to put on and take off thanks to a self-stick back closure, with padding at the knees and waist for comfortable play.

A set of three reusable stainless steel straws for drinking mate, tea, and other beverages. The flared filter end lets liquid through while holding back loose leaves, and the spoon-shaped tip helps scoop out spent mate. Each straw is compact enough to carry in a pocket or backpack.

specs.format: Workbook with flash cards and stickers
specs.subjects: Reading, writing, math, science, social studies

record.description: A summer learning workbook that helps children carry skills from fourth grade into fifth. Short daily activities of about 15 minutes cover language arts, math, and science. Stickers, flash cards, an award certificate, and an answer key are included.

specs.use: Indoor planter, storage for toys, crafts, towels

record.description: A pair of hand-woven cotton rope baskets in two sizes, suited to hold indoor plants or to store toys, crafts, and towels. Their natural, minimal look fits easily into most rooms, and the set makes a practical gift.

A men's dress watch from Bulova with a tonneau-shaped stainless steel case and a black leather-alligator strap. It runs on an analog-quartz movement and has a curved mineral crystal. Rated water resistant to 30 meters for splashes or brief immersion, not for swimming.

specs.water resistance: Waterproof, stain resistant, salt or fresh water
specs.use: Water and outdoor sports

record.description: A neoprene retainer strap that keeps sunglasses secured around the neck or on the head during outdoor and water activities. It floats, resists water and stains, and is suitable for most frame styles. Test with your glasses before relying on it in water, since heavier frames may exceed its floating capacity.

specs.features: Built-in handles, open top, stackable
specs.care: Hand wash with soap and water; not dishwasher safe
specs.use: Office, desk drawers, filing cabinets, closets

record.description: A set of four clear plastic bins with built-in handles for keeping office and desk supplies tidy. The open tops and see-through walls make items easy to spot, and the bins stack for use in drawers, cabinets, shelves, and small spaces. Made of durable plastic, they can be wiped clean with soap and water.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, no bleach, tumble dry low

record.description: A pair of soft chenille throw pillow covers in cream with mixed black accents and a brief textured design. Each 18 by 18 inch cover fits a 20 inch pillow form and has a hidden zipper for easy insertion and washing. Suitable for sofas, beds, chairs, and other seating.

specs.filling: All-natural grain and dried French lavender
specs.use: Microwavable hot and cold therapy
specs.safety: Meets U.S. safety standards for all ages

record.description: A 20-inch plush soft toy that can be heated in the microwave or cooled for gentle therapy. Filled with natural grain and dried French lavender for a soothing scent and warmth. Made from soft fabric and suitable for bedtime, travel, or everyday comfort.

specs.block size: 6 in L x 6 in W x 6 in H
specs.safety certifications: GREENGUARD Gold, CPSIA, CA-117, ASTM F963
specs.cleaning: Wipe with mild soap and water or bleach-free wipe

record.description: A set of 12 soft foam blocks designed for toddlers to stack, build, and explore. The bright primary colors help little ones learn colors while developing coordination and imagination. Each block is easy to wipe clean and matches the companion play mat.

specs.dimensions: 18 in H x 13 in W x 9 in D

record.description: A lightweight, water-repellent backpack suited to travel, hiking, camping, and everyday use. Its fabric wipes clean easily. Exterior and interior pockets, a trolley sleeve for luggage, and a shoe compartment keep belongings organized.

A slim, lightweight protective case built for the iPhone 11 Pro Max only, not the iPhone 11 or 11 Pro. Its flexible matte TPU shell is easy to put on and take off, offers a smooth, comfortable grip, and keeps the phone's original curve while adding little bulk. Cutouts line up with the buttons, camera, flash, speakers and Lightning port.

A lightweight long-sleeve crewneck sweater for women with a classic, close-but-comfortable fit that moves easily with you. Made with soft yarn, it features ribbed trim at the collar, cuffs, and hem for a neat finish. A versatile black layer for everyday wear.

specs.active ingredient: Iodine 250 mcg from sea kelp (Ascophyllum nodosum)
specs.certifications: GMO free, soy free, gluten free

record.description: A vegetarian iodine supplement in capsule form, with 250 mcg of iodine from dried sea kelp grown in the USA. Iodine is an essential trace mineral that supports normal thyroid function. The 60-capsule bottle provides about a two-month supply. Free of added preservatives and artificial ingredients.

specs.dimensions: 20 x 14 x 7 inch (50 x 35 x 18 cm)

record.description: A black carry-on travel backpack with an expandable main compartment offering up to 40 liters for short trips. It has hideaway shoulder straps, multiple carrying handles, a luggage strap, and a padded laptop sleeve. Water-resistant polyester construction with front organizer pockets and a zippered anti-theft back pocket.

Mars Black acrylic paint in a 75 mL tube. The opaque, vibrant formula blends smoothly and dries to a waterproof finish. Tubes are peggable for convenient storage, and the paint is labeled non-toxic under ASTM D 4236.

A long, striped Santa hat in red and white, finished with faux fur trim and a pom-pom on top. Its soft felt and plush fabric make it comfortable to wear, and it suits teens and adults for Christmas festivities.

specs.interior: Zippered organization pockets, elastic shoe pockets, garment restraint panel

record.description: A rose gold 28-inch checked upright suitcase made of ABS with an expandable design that adds two extra inches of capacity. Eight multi-directional spinner wheels aid maneuvering, and a retractable trolley handle makes pulling easy. Inside, zippered pockets, elastic shoe pockets, and a garment restraint keep items organized. Corner guards help reinforce the shell.

specs.features: Left chest pocket, tagless back neck label, taped neck and shoulder seams

record.description: A two-pack of men's short sleeve t-shirts in white, made from pre-shrunk cotton. Each shirt has a left chest pocket with a small exterior logo, a tagless neck label for comfort, and taped neck and shoulder seams for durability.

A classic European-style vanity stool with a padded, cushioned seat and slightly flared legs. Its MDF frame and solid wood legs give it a stable base, and carved detailing adds character. Suited to a dressing table, it also works as a dining, lounge, piano, or shoe stool.

A navy kitchen island with a solid wood butcher block top suited to food prep or extra serving space. Two smooth-glide drawers and three cabinets offer storage, and included casters or feet let you choose a movable cart or a stationary island. Brushed nickel hardware completes the look.

specs.surfaces: Plastic, wood, stone, metal, glass, paper

record.description: A set of 60 permanent markers in bright, vivid assorted colors with a fine tip. The quick-drying ink is waterproof, smear-proof and fade-resistant, suited to doodling, coloring, scrapbooking and marking on paper, plastic, wood, metal and glass.

Men's Golden Goose Superstar low-top sneakers in grey, combining a suede-style upper with smooth blue leather heel tab and star detailing. Built with leather and a rubber sole for comfortable everyday wear. Classic leisure design with a vintage finish that pairs easily with casual outfits.
A men's slip-on sneaker from Quiksilver in grey with white accents. Its no-sew mesh upper is joined by welded construction and molded structural underlays for a performance fit.

A white marine digital media receiver from Sony with built-in Bluetooth for wireless audio. Its IPx5-rated design resists water spray, and a front USB port plays music from compatible devices. It also supports SiriusXM satellite radio and pairs with 6.5 inch dual cone speakers.

A bare-board switching power supply module that converts 100-240V AC mains to a regulated 24V DC output, suited to industrial control systems. Its double-sided PCB design aims for stable operation, and it includes over-voltage, over-current and short-circuit protection.

A modern ombre area rug from SAFAVIEH's Adirondack collection, machine-woven from synthetic fibers that resist stains and shed very little. Its low pile suits busy households with kids or pets, and the silver and black design fits living rooms, bedrooms, dining areas, and home offices. Routine vacuuming and gentle spot cleaning keep it looking good.

specs.construction: Faux fur front, sherpa back, reversible
specs.care: Fade and stain resistant

record.description: A soft, plush throw blanket with a faux fur front and fluffy sherpa back, designed to feel like real mink. Its understated tie-dye pattern adds a stylish accent to a couch, chair, or bed, and it can also be tucked between a comforter and sheet for extra warmth.
A women's slide sandal from Ted Baker in the Avelini style, finished in a bright yellow shade called Magnificent Yellow. Offered in US women's size 8.5 Regular, it suits casual everyday wear.
