A decorative throw pillow featuring a campfire scene with white lettering joking that camping without beer is just sitting in the woods. Printed on both sides with a fun novelty design suited to camping fans and couples. Made of spun-polyester fabric and filled with polyester.

Men's no show socks sold as a six-pair pack in black with Onix marl accents. Lightweight Superlite knit construction, a large adidas wordmark on the outside of the foot, and moisture-wicking yarn to help keep feet dry during activity.

specs.closure: Elastic ankle strap with heel zipper

record.description: Minimalist black ballet flats with a soft faux suede upper and an elastic ankle strap. A heel zipper makes them easy to slip on and off. Cushioned, flexible soles suit everyday walking, and the simple design pairs well with casual and semi-formal outfits.

specs.frame: Pine wood frame, ready to hang
specs.mounting: Black hook pre-mounted on wooden bar

record.description: Framed giclee wall art printed on waterproof archival canvas and stretched over a pine frame. Features a simple, elegant abstract floral blossom design in gray and yellow. Ready to hang out of the box, suited to living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, offices and dining areas. Colors may vary slightly depending on monitor settings.

A full figure underwire bra from Wacoal's Retro Chic line in ivory. Two-part seamed cups aim to provide lift, shape, and support, with a sheer mesh window at the top of each cup. The band and sides are designed to lie smooth and reduce bulge.

Individual eyelash extensions in a classic style, offered in mixed or single lengths from 8 to 15mm. Available in several L-series curls and two thicknesses for a range of looks. The lashes are described as soft, very black, and gentle on skin and eyes, and they lift from the strip cleanly without residue or kinks.

specs.feature: Transforms into a backpack in one motion

record.description: A lightweight indoor and outdoor lounge for babies that folds into a backpack in one motion. It comes with a removable activity bar and canopy, has a waterproof base, and its cover can be machine washed. The design is award winning and has been safety tested and certified.

specs.construction: Triple layer: hard PC shell with soft silicone inner skin
specs.protection: Shockproof, raised bezel for screen and camera
specs.features: Cutouts for buttons and ports, attached dust caps

record.description: A slim, lightweight protective case for the iPod Touch 5th, 6th, and 7th generation. It pairs a hard outer shell with a soft silicone inner layer to absorb shocks from small drops. A raised edge guards the screen and camera, while cutouts keep buttons and ports easy to reach.

specs.care: Hand wash with mild soap and water; not dishwasher safe

record.description: A refillable pump dispenser for liquid hand soap, dish soap, hand sanitizer, or essential oils. Its compact round frosted body suits bathroom vanities, small pedestal sinks, and kitchen sinks. The removable pump head and wide opening make refilling simple. Made of plastic that resists moisture and rust.

specs.coverage: Up to 500 sq. ft. per kit
specs.cure time: Walk on in 8-10 hours, vehicle ready in 24 hours

record.description: A self-leveling, buildable polycuramine coating for interior concrete floors such as garages, workshops, and basements. Its high-gloss terrazzo finish resists cracking, peeling, chemical spills, and hot tire pickup. Packaged in a six-piece set with a low-VOC, low-odor formula.

specs.battery life: About a month or more per charge
specs.surface: Edge-to-edge glass, nearly 30% larger than previous trackpad
specs.touch technology: Force Touch with four force sensors

record.description: A wireless, rechargeable trackpad for desktop computers featuring Force Touch, which lets you click anywhere and respond to varying pressure. Its larger glass surface and low profile make scrolling and swiping comfortable. It pairs automatically with a Mac and runs for about a month between charges.

specs.burn: Low smoke, lasts up to 24 hours in a room

record.description: Natural vetiver incense sticks with a light, woodsy and earthy fragrance, rolled in Vietnam. Each pack holds 68 sticks, 11 inches long, totaling 200 grams. Suited to meditation, yoga, worship and relaxing at home, with a low-smoke burn.

specs.material: Dotted mesh with stretch lace trim

record.description: An unlined women's bralette with dotted mesh cups and stretch lace trim at the cups, underarm, and underband. Features adjustable double rouleau elastic straps and rose gold tone hardware for a customizable fit.

A red countertop pizza oven that handles frozen, pre-baked, or fresh dough pizzas. Its removable stone helps crust bake evenly and crisp. Upper and lower heating elements and adjustable temperature control reach up to about 680 degrees F, with a preheat function to get started quickly.

specs.style: 3 in 1 interchange ski jacket with detachable hood

record.description: A women's 3-in-1 winter jacket that can be worn as a combined ski coat, a waterproof rain shell, or a standalone insulated liner. It has a detachable adjustable hood, elastic cuffs, and a 5000mm waterproof, windproof exterior that resists dirt and grease. Zip pockets keep essentials secure on the slopes or outdoors.

specs.size: One size, fits most teens and adults

record.description: A deluxe feather headdress for Halloween costumes and role play. It features large faux feathers in black, white, and blue, with white marabou trim along the sides. Designed to fit most teens and adults, it suits costume parties and themed events.

A pre-owned Rolex ladies' Datejust President watch with an 18k yellow gold case, bezel, and bracelet paired with a silver dial. Automatic movement. Listed in excellent condition, with any necessary service completed and a final quality check before shipment.

A six-pair assortment of women's crew socks with colorful patterns and solid rainbow shades. Made from combed cotton blended with spandex for a snug, elastic fit. Suited to both athletic activity and everyday casual wear.

specs.product type: Matte lip crayon with built-in lip balm
specs.set contents: Six lip crayon shades plus lip balm

record.description: A two-in-one matte lip kit pairing a buildable lip crayon with a built-in nourishing lip balm. The pointed crayon tip helps define lips, and the balm can add a glossy shine over the matte color. Offered in six everyday shades.

specs.frame: Powder coated aluminum with steel ribs

record.description: A 9 foot half patio umbrella with a beige water resistant polyester canopy and a crank winder for easy height adjustment. A push button tilt angles the shade, and a large top vent improves airflow. Suited to balconies, decks and poolside tables. Base stand sold separately.

A four-pack of Mainstays scented candles in the Mulled Cider fragrance, each housed in a glass jar with three wicks. Designed to fill a room with a warm, spiced cider scent, these candles suit gatherings, relaxing evenings, and everyday home decor. Store in a cool place for best results.

A lightweight, high-waisted mid-thigh shaping short from SPANX designed to smooth the lower stomach. Its breathable microfiber build is meant to feel weightless, and the cotton gusset is intended to help reduce visible panty lines.

specs.care: Machine wash cool, tumble dry low

record.description: A four-pack of seamless racerback bralettes for girls, with spaghetti straps that stay hidden under tops. Each has removable pads and a tag-free, lightweight stretch fabric for all-day comfort. Breathable and suited to training, the gym, or everyday wear.

A women's 6-inch industrial and construction boot with an alloy safety toe for protection on the job. Made from waterproof full-grain leather with a membrane, it is built on a women's last for a comfortable fit. An all-weather outsole and anti-fatigue footbed support long shifts.

specs.lens coating: HDC multicoating and AquaDura outer lens coating

record.description: Compact 10x25 binocular with a rubber-armored, waterproof housing rated to about 16.5 feet. Central focusing knob allows quick, precise adjustment, and multicoated optics with an outer water- and scratch-resistant coating support clear, sharp views.

specs.type: Keyboard case with detachable Bluetooth keyboard
specs.material: PU leather cover, polycarbonate shell, ABS keyboard
specs.included: Case, Bluetooth keyboard, Micro USB cable, user manual

record.description: A slim protective case with a removable Bluetooth keyboard for the Galaxy Tab S4 10.5 (2018 release). The backlit keys offer several colors and brightness levels for typing in dim light. An adjustable stand holds the tablet in landscape mode, and a built-in holder keeps an S Pen handy. The tablet itself is not included.

A set of jumbo disposable plastic straws with wide openings at both ends, sized to reach the bottom of tall cups. Suited to smoothies, milkshakes, pearl milk tea and iced drinks. Mixed bright colors make them fun for parties, barbecues and picnics. They can be washed and reused or used for crafts.

A women's rock climbing and bouldering shoe in purple with a leather upper that offers some stretch and breathability. The lace closure lets you fine-tune the fit around the foot. The smooth last suits longer wear, and front edge protection helps keep the foot from rolling off holds. Designed for a higher instep and narrower foot shape.

specs.pockets: 2 pocket folder with interior die-cut business card holder
specs.capacity: Holds up to 50 sheets per pocket

record.description: A box of 25 green letter-size folders with a glossy laminated finish. Each folder has two pockets and an interior business card holder, suited to presentations, school projects, or client leave-behinds. The laminated construction resists tearing better than standard paper folders.

specs.palm: Partial synthetic leather with silicone grip
specs.closure: Magnetic convertible mitten to fingerless glove

record.description: Convertible winter mittens that flip open into fingerless gloves using magnets, so your fingers stay free for fishing, photography, or phone use. Insulated with Thinsulate and fleece, with a windproof membrane and grippy palms. Reflective strips add visibility on dark winter runs. Best for mild cold rather than extreme conditions.

specs.pockets: Two button-through welt pockets at rear

record.description: Men's slim-fit dress pants with a flat front and a tapered leg that is fitted through the hip and thigh. Made from smooth, flexible polyester twill that moves with you. Sits below the waist and includes two rear welt pockets with button closures. Available in black, 28 inches in waist and length.

specs.care: Machine wash up to 30°C/86°F

record.description: A lightweight women's hooded jacket with a soft faux sheepskin lining and an echo-lamb lined fixed hood. Its double zip closure and invisible-zip pockets suit wind and rain protection. The jacket packs into its own pouch for easy carrying.

specs.care: Machine wash and tumble dry

record.description: A six-pair set of crew-length baby socks for year-round wear, combining cooling mesh socks with thermal waffle socks. Cushioned soles add comfort and non-skid grippers help reduce slipping. Suitable for unisex babies in the 6-12 month range. Machine washable and dryer safe.

Sheer organza ribbon with wired edges that hold shape for bows, wreaths, and floral arrangements. The polyester fabric is waterproof and holds its color outdoors, suiting holiday decorations and gift wrapping.

specs.material: 304 stainless steel strap, zinc-plated bolt and nut

record.description: A removable, reusable lap joint exhaust clamp that joins 3-inch pipe sections without welding. Its stainless steel strap spreads clamping force evenly around the joint to help seal against leaks. Best suited where a clean appearance and easy disassembly matter, such as mufflers and exhaust tips. Needs enough straight pipe before the joint.

A large cotton canvas drop cloth for covering floors, carpets, and furniture indoors or outdoors. It soaks up paint spills and traps dust and debris, and it can be machine washed for repeated use. Double-stitched seams help it resist fraying over time.

specs.style: Stemmed martini glass, 2-piece cup and base
specs.use: Disposable or reusable

record.description: Disposable stemmed plastic martini glasses with a clear, glass-like look for elegant presentation of desserts, appetizers, mousse, and beverages. Each set of 30 includes cups and bases for easy assembly. Suitable for weddings, parties, and everyday serving, and can be washed and reused.

White aerosol paint for striping athletic fields. Formulated to be used inverted with marking machines, and its universal tip fits most competitors' aerosol marking equipment. Dries quickly and covers in a single coat. Sold as a two-case pack of 24 cans.
Rectangular full-rim sunglasses from Gucci in a Dark Havana frame with green silver mirror lenses. Plastic frame with 100% UV protection and non-polarized lenses. Designed for men and unisex wear.
A small travel-size eau de parfum spray from Versace's Eros Pour Femme women's fragrance line. The 0.17 ounce bottle makes it easy to try the scent or carry it along on the go.

specs.features: Secure hand pockets, dual zipper

record.description: A lightweight women's long down winter jacket from Columbia with a hood. Its 650-fill down insulation provides warmth, and the water-resistant shell adds protection in wet conditions. Secure hand pockets and a dual zipper complete the design.

specs.features: Altitude hold, GPS, Return-to-Home, headless mode
specs.included: Quadcopter, remote, battery, 4 protection rings, 4 propellers, USB cable, manual

record.description: A compact mini quadcopter with a folding frame and replaceable arms, designed for easy transport. It offers altitude hold, GPS tracking with a Return-to-Home function, headless flight mode, and 360-degree rolls controlled by a 4-channel remote. This standard version ships without a camera.

Reusable silicone ear plugs in three sizes (small, medium, large) for sleeping, snoring, or blocking everyday noise. The oval shape follows the ear canal for a snug seal, and the attached hooks help keep them in place overnight. Made to be washed and reused, and designed to be gentle on the ears.

A high-rise, A-line maxi denim skirt in light blue with a flared silhouette and a curved waist. Features contrast stitching, functional front and back pockets, and a button-and-zipper closure. Suited to work, school, or casual outings across several seasons.

Full-coverage women's performance leggings with a side stripe design in black and blue. A flat, wide waistband and flatlock stitching aim to keep them comfortable and flexible for workouts. Mid-rise cut with a 7/8 length, suited to a range of sports and training.

An oval tin wall sign from Harley-Davidson with a raised, die-cut graphic featuring the Bar & Shield logo and script lettering. Measuring 18 by 10.5 inches, it has holes for easy hanging in a garage, shop, or other room. A fitting gift for a Harley enthusiast.

specs.power: Single power per pack, not mixed

record.description: A four-pack of oversized square reading glasses designed for women, with spring hinges and a plastic frame. Each pair in the set shares one magnification strength. Suitable for reading at home or in the office. Lenses should be cleaned gently, avoiding paper towels, alcohol, and harsh soaps.

specs.compatibility: Apple iPhone 7 Plus / iPhone 8 Plus (5.5 inch)

record.description: A slim, lightweight soft silicone case for the Apple iPhone 7 Plus and 8 Plus. Its smoke-toned skeleton design adds a unique look while protecting the phone from scratches, dust, and minor bumps. Openings allow access to the audio jack, charger port, and volume buttons. Easy to put on and remove.

A multi-colored six-strand cotton embroidery floss with an over-dyed effect, sold as an 8-pack in a holiday colorway. Each skein holds 8.7 yards, suited to cross-stitch, embroidery, and other needlework projects.

An 85-inch 4K UHD smart TV with QLED Quantum Dot display and dual LED backlighting for contrast and color. Quantum HDR widens the color range, and an AI-based processor upscales lower-resolution content to 4K. Alexa is built in, and the slim design suits modern rooms.

A white gold promise ring set with small round cubic zirconia stones, offered in women's size 6.5 and men's size 10.5 for couples. Its minimalist design suits anniversaries, Valentine's Day, and other gift occasions. Store it in a box or pouch away from water, perfume, and chemicals to keep its shine.

A long sleeve fishing shirt from Columbia's PFG line with a tribal-inspired graphic. Its polyester interlock fabric dries quickly and moves moisture away from the skin, and the tight weave with UV-absorbing yarns helps block harmful sun rays. Suited to the water or a beachside campfire.

specs.features: Moisture wicking, tag free, double needle hem

record.description: A five-pack of men's undershirts in grey and black, sized X-Large. The soft, tag-free shirts have a double needle hem and a moisture-wicking finish to help keep you cool and dry.

specs.strap: 20mm black genuine leather, adjustable up to 8-inch wrist

record.description: A men's smartwatch with a silver-tone brass case and a white dial with green hour markers. It tracks steps, distance, calories and sleep, syncs with a phone over Bluetooth, and includes Indiglo backlighting and a multi-time display. The black leather strap uses quick-release spring bars.

Lightweight running shoe for kids with a black and white colorway. A dial closure offers a quick, adjustable fit without laces. The breathable mesh upper and foam midsole are designed for comfort, while the rubber outsole supports traction on varied surfaces.

A hair clipper from Andis with an alloy housing designed to run cooler, quieter, and with less vibration than earlier models. Its adjustable carbon steel blade sets from 000 to 1 and can be zero-gapped. The ergonomic body supports a comfortable grip for longer sessions, and the two-tone black and chrome styling looks sleek.

specs.closure: Self fabric belt with 2 belt loops
specs.care: Machine wash with like colors, tumble dry low, no iron

record.description: A men's hooded bathrobe in black, made from Turkish cotton with loops on both sides to absorb moisture. It is cut to ankle length and features a wide hood, two patch pockets, and a self-fabric belt. Suited to use after a sauna, gym, pool, or at the beach.

specs.type: Gaming chair with massage lumbar cushion
specs.features: 360 swivel, rocking, height-adjustable, detachable headrest

record.description: A red ergonomic gaming and office chair with a metal frame, adjustable seat and armrests, and a 360-degree swivel. It reclines between 90 and 170 degrees and includes a detachable headrest and a USB-powered vibrating lumbar cushion for long sessions.

A royal blue ball gown of sequined tulle with a sweetheart neckline and sleeveless bodice. Decorated with 3D floral appliques, pearls and beading, it has a corset back and floor-length hem. Suited to quinceanera, prom, and formal evening events. Made to order.

specs.care: Machine washable, pre-shrunk

record.description: A short-sleeve orange t-shirt with a Tampa Bay football fan design reading No Risk It, No Biscuit. Made from 100% cotton, pre-shrunk, and machine washable, with the print screen printed in the USA.

specs.connectivity: USB receiver or Bluetooth Low Energy

record.description: A wireless laser presenter for slideshows, compatible with PowerPoint, Keynote, PDF and Google Slides. It connects by a tiny USB receiver or Bluetooth, works from up to 20 meters away, and stores its receiver in a built-in dock. Customizable buttons are available through a companion app.

A chrome replacement tub spout for Delta faucets, model RP4370, made to original specifications. It fits pull-out diverter setups used with hand showers and works with 1/2-inch or 3/4-inch standard pipe. Built to be tested for reliable performance.

specs.type: Mechanical pencil and ballpoint pen set

record.description: A matching stainless steel pencil and ballpoint pen set in a polished silver finish. The mechanical pencil takes 0.7mm HB lead and the pen uses 0.8mm black ink for smooth, accurate writing. A knurled grip helps keep a steady hold, and the quiet retraction plunger suits focused work. Packaged as a gift set.

specs.care: Machine washable, dryer safe

record.description: A quilted heated mattress pad in white, sized for a king bed. Dual side controllers each offer 10 heat settings, and dual-sided heating aims to keep warmth consistent through the night. An auto-off function adds peace of mind. Made of soft polyester that can be machine washed and dried.

A men's quartz wristwatch with a natural wooden case and stainless steel bracelet, engravable for a personal gift. A hand-carved pink Himalayan salt lamp with a unique shape, mounted on a natural neem wood base. Its integrated dimmer adjusts the warm orange glow for daytime or nighttime use. Arrives fully assembled with a spare bulb, making it a relaxing bedroom or living room accent or a housewarming gift.

Men's sneaker from adidas Originals with a knit upper and mesh lining for a lightweight fit. Features webbing tape three-stripe detailing, a nubuck heel, an OrthoLite sockliner for cushioned comfort, and a speed lacing system for quick adjustment.

A 10-inch silicone whisk for blending, whisking, beating, stirring, cooking, and baking. The silicone-coated wire is meant to be gentle on pots, pans, and other cookware, and it is easy to clean.

A women's full-zip fleece jacket built from soft polyester fleece for warmth on cool days. Two side zippered pockets keep small items secure, and a collared neck adds comfort. Its modern classic fit is lightweight with an active cut suited to outdoor activity.

A sonic electric toothbrush for adults with five cleaning modes and three intensity levels. Its motor delivers a wide brush head swing and fast vibration to help lift plaque. A bundle of six bunches of Giant Hairgrass, a live freshwater aquarium plant with a sturdy root system that draws nutrients from substrate. It forms a full background cover for tanks and offers shelter for fish while helping to oxygenate and clean the water.

A wearable blanket for big kids that replaces loose bedding. The sack-style design leaves room to move while staying secured through the night. Foot openings let children walk around when awake and tuck their feet in at bedtime. Soft micro-fleece in cream with a dog print.

record.description: A novelty pajama set with a Star Trek TNG theme in dark tones. The crewneck top and relaxed-fit bottoms are made of soft cotton for lounging or sleeping. Bottoms have a no-fly string waist, and the set is printed for a casual look.

Men's handsewn leather shoe from Timberland in a burgundy and brown colorway. The upper is stitched to the midsole and cemented to a rubber lug outsole for traction. Rawhide lacing wraps around the foot for a custom fit, and a full-length EVA insert with Poron forefoot padding adds cushioning.

A unisex crewneck sweatshirt featuring a Hawkins Middle School AV Club screen-printed design in white ink. Made from a soft 50/50 blend and printed in the USA. Runs large for women, so consider sizing accordingly. A fun gift for fans of the show.

A cordless, hoseless handheld pool vacuum for cleaning inground, above ground, and soft-sided pools. It runs on a rechargeable lithium ion battery, offers push-button operation, and can be attached to a standard telescopic pool pole. The removable head allows spot cleaning of hard-to-reach areas.

A full-frame professional DSLR camera from Canon with a 20.1 megapixel sensor and DIGIC X processor. Offers 4K video, a 191-point autofocus system with subject tracking, and fast continuous shooting. Includes a CFexpress card and reader bundle.

A low-profile wall mount for flat and curved LED, LCD, and plasma TVs and monitors from 37 to 80 inches. Pre-assembled with a quick-release locking mechanism and open wall plate for concealed cable management.

A soft, stretchy long-sleeve romper for newborns, made from a breathable cotton blend that is gentle on sensitive skin. A hardcover notebook from Moleskine's limited Sakura edition, offering 240 ruled pages of thick ivory paper suited to ballpoint, pencil, and fountain pens. It includes an elastic closure band and inner storage folders for notes and writing projects.

Lightweight first-walker sneakers for babies learning to walk. The breathable mesh upper keeps little feet cool and dry, while the rubber soles with grip spikes help prevent slipping. A reinforced toe cap offers protection, and the knit collar makes them quick to put on and take off.

A rechargeable touch-sensor closet light that sticks on almost anywhere. Its swivel head aims light up and down, and an anti-glare panel gives soft illumination. Touch the metal pins to switch modes and dim, and it remembers your last brightness setting.

Individually wrapped essential oil towelettes for cleaning hands and surfaces without harsh alcohol or chemicals. Compact enough to carry in a purse, backpack, or pocket for use on flights, buses, or in public restrooms.

specs.compatibility: MacBook Pro 2016/2017, Galaxy S8, Chromebook Pixel

A flexible single-face corrugated cardboard roll for wrapping fragile items such as glass and metal parts. Its raised A-flute layer cushions against shocks and crushing, and the material conforms to many shapes. Made from recyclable material in the USA.

A self-propelled gas lawn mower suited to smaller yards, with a 170cc engine, a 20-inch steel deck, and three functions: side discharge, mulching, and rear bagging. Eight height settings and a rear-wheel drive mode help it handle uneven ground and tight spaces.

A wire-free everyday bra from Hanes designed for lightweight, second-skin comfort. A comfort band helps it stay in place, and flexible foam cups add shape and support. Its sleek profile is meant to stay virtually invisible under clothing.

specs.handle: 6 inch hand strap with rivet-reinforced leather binds

record.description: A handcrafted insulated lunch bag made from waxed canvas, sized to carry a full lunch for work, school, or a picnic. The lining helps keep food warm or cold, and the wipe-clean exterior resists spills. A reinforced carry handle makes it easy to take along on the commute.

specs.features: Shimmering patterned fabric on hooves and horn

record.description: A soft plush unicorn with a white body and bright purple mane and tail. Shimmering patterned fabric accents the hooves and horn, and weighted hooves help it stand steadily. Made from durable plush and fill, and the surface can be wiped clean.

A twin-size navy bed sheet set made from 100% cotton with a 500 thread count sateen weave for a smooth, soft feel. Includes a flat sheet, a fitted sheet with deep pockets, and two pillowcases. Machine washable for easy care.

specs.type: Car cup holder phone mount with wireless charger
specs.mount: Cup holder base with adjustable aluminum arm

record.description: A car phone holder that fits into a cup holder and grips your phone automatically when it is placed in the clamps. A long sleeve girls' dress in a soft cotton-polyester jersey blend, featuring an allover fair isle print. It has a crew neckline, a pullover design, and an elasticized waist for easy wear. Sized 5T for toddler girls.

A compact square side table with a lower shelf for extra storage, suited to small rooms. Its steel tubing frame offers sturdy support, and the rich brown wood grain finish wipes clean easily. Simple to assemble.

specs.use: Glass pipe/rig cleaning, storage, odor proofing

specs.material: Fiber-reinforced polycarbonate with stainless steel hardware

record.description: A dual tray for underwater camera setups that holds two lights or flashes at once to increase brightness, reduce shadows, and steady the rig. Attaches and detaches quickly with a click, and fits cameras with a standard 1/4-20 tripod mount.

A single clear acrylic taper ear plug for stretched ears, measuring 12mm (1/2 inch). Pink heart and glitter confetti pattern is suspended inside the clear body. Includes two rubber O-rings. Buy two for a matching pair.

specs.material: E1 standard wood panel, 1.2 mm metal frame
specs.assembly: 4 legs with hex key, about 5-10 minutes

record.description: A spacious 63-inch writing desk with a square, traditional design and a glossy finish. The waterproof, scratch-resistant wood panel is easy to wipe clean, and the metal frame gives solid support. Suited to home offices, meeting tables, or conference use, with adjustable legs for uneven floors.

specs.display: Cup in front, saucer standing behind

record.description: A set of six clear display easels for showing a teacup and its saucer together. Each stand holds one cup with the saucer propped behind it, so both pieces stay visible. Suited to kitchen shelves, dining rooms, or curio cabinets, and a thoughtful gift for a dishware collector.

specs.use: Medical, nursing, travel, flight, running, fitness, pregnancy

record.description: A set of eight pairs of graduated compression socks for women and men, offering 15-20 mmHg support. Made from a nylon-rich blend for comfort, breathability and moisture absorption, they suit medical, travel, running and everyday use. Sold in L/XL black.

specs.material: Solid polished brass with wood handle

record.description: A vintage-style school bell with a solid polished brass bell and a wooden handle. It works as a functional hand bell and also serves as a decorative accent piece for home or classroom use.

A long sleeve fishing tee from Columbia's PFG line, made from quick-drying polyester interlock. Built-in UPF 50 sun protection and moisture-wicking fabric help keep you cool and dry on the water. Cut for a classic, comfortable fit.

A pack of ten black gel ink pens with a fine 0.38 mm tip for smooth, precise writing. The pigment-based ink is designed to be waterproof and fade-resistant, suited to note-taking, calendar marking, and everyday writing.

specs.material: 300GSM cardboard, plastic window, natural jute twine

record.description: A set of 14 black bakery boxes with an openable window, sized for cupcakes, macarons, and cookies. Each box folds together without tools. A jute twine bundle is included for wrapping and carrying. Suited to party favors, birthdays, and holiday gifts, with a blank surface for custom decoration.

specs.material: Denim, soft lightweight with some stretch
specs.style: Bib overall shorts with raw hem

record.description: Casual women's denim bib overall shorts with a distressed look and raw cuffed hem. Adjustable straps with metal buckles offer a flexible fit. Four pockets add practicality. Soft, breathable fabric with slight stretch suits everyday wear, travel, and summer outings.

Sterling silver stud earrings with rhodium plating, set with princess-cut cubic zirconia and a cushion-shaped halo. A simple, sparkling design that suits everyday wear or special occasions. Comes with a drawstring jewelry pouch for gifting or storage.

specs.package: Registration details on packaging, no CD

record.description: A downloadable will kit with forms and instructions for drafting a legal will to allocate assets, name beneficiaries, and appoint a guardian for minor children. Registration is required to access the current, state-specific content. Intended for use in the United States only.

specs.pack contents: 4 vehicle puzzles: steamer, airplane, car, police car
specs.packaging: Drawstring cloth carrying pouch and gift box

record.description: A set of four wooden vehicle jigsaw puzzles for toddlers aged one to three. Each chunky piece has smooth, rounded edges and bright colors to help little hands practice picking and placing. The puzzles support early recognition of vehicles, hand-eye coordination, and concentration, and can be played indoors, outdoors, or while traveling with family or friends.

specs.type: Semi flush mount ceiling fan with light

record.description: A modern low-profile ceiling fan with an integrated LED light, offering three fan speeds, dimmable brightness, and three selectable color temperatures. Includes a remote and a sleep night-light mode. The white lampshade and black shell suit living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and studies.

specs.max_wattage: 180W total, up to 60W per E26 bulb

record.description: A chrome flush mount ceiling light with a crystal shade of 143 K9 crystal balls that catch and reflect light whether on or off. Suited to entryways, hallways, dining rooms, and bedrooms, it works with dimmable E26 bulbs and includes an installation manual.

A halo engagement ring in sterling silver with a round clear cubic zirconia center stone surrounded by micro-pave stones that also run along the band. Rhodium plated and nickel free, suited to sensitive skin. Presented in a leather box.

specs.compatibility: iPhone 11, iPhone 11 Pro, iPhone 11 Pro Max
specs.card slots: 3 card slots and a cash slot
specs.features: Auto wake/sleep, kickstand stand feature

record.description: A wallet-style protective case for iPhone 11, 11 Pro, and 11 Pro Max featuring an anime-inspired One Piece Sabo design. It combines a slim shell with a leather card pocket for a few cards and cash, and includes a fold-out stand for viewing videos or video calls. Cutouts provide access to buttons, camera, speaker, and charging port.

specs.installation: No drilling, hook tape and Velcro
specs.care: Water resistant and washable

record.description: A nylon window seal that closes the triangular side gaps of an open awning or casement window, so a portable air conditioner or tumble dryer exhaust hose can pass through with less warm air flowing back inside. It attaches with hook tape and zips closed around the hose without wall drilling, and can be removed and stored.

specs.material: Absorbent polyester fabric with waterproof backing
specs.care: Machine washable; do not bleach

record.description: A low-profile dish drying mat that soaks up water and keeps countertops dry. Machine washable and durable.

A solar charging battery pack for Suntek hunting and trail cameras, providing backup power so the camera keeps running in the field. It includes overload and overdischarge protection, mounts to a tree, pole, or camera tripod, and is rated IP 65 for weather resistance. Compatible with a range of Suntek trail camera models.

Men's mesh athletic shorts from Russell Athletic in black. The breathable mesh build aims to keep air flowing, and Dri-Power technology is designed to wick moisture. An elastic waistband with an internal draw cord allows an adjustable fit, and side pockets hold small essentials.

A slim-fitting long-sleeve knit top in white with a cross-wrap asymmetrical neckline and ribbed texture. Its stretchy blend of polyester, cotton, and spandex suits easy pairing with pants, skirts, shorts, or jeans. Runs small, so check the size chart, especially bust measurements.

specs.lighting: LEDs light up as wheels turn, no batteries

record.description: Clip-on heel wheels that turn ordinary shoes into roller skates for children aged six and up. Adjustable fit suits many shoe types. Wheels contain LEDs that glow as they spin, requiring no batteries. Includes a rubber strap for security and a larger brake for stopping. Supports users up to 132 pounds.

Matte white graphic art tape for drawing clean, even straight lines on charts, crafts, decorations and signs. Its permanent adhesive holds well indoors and outdoors on clean, dry plastic, glass, metal, wood, paper, ceramic and whiteboard surfaces.

specs.assembled dimensions: 54.53 L x 29.92 W x 18.90 H inches

record.description: A toddler bed made of sturdy wood with a PAW Patrol theme, designed for children from 15 months up. Two high side rails help keep little sleepers safe during the move toward a big kid bed. Assembly is straightforward, and the bed is JPMA certified to meet CPSC and ASTM safety standards.

specs.size: 52 in wide x 84 in long per panel
specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle; tumble dry; cool iron if needed; do not bleach

record.description: A pair of solid ivory sheer window panels with a textured linen-style finish. Each panel hangs from silver grommets along the top edge. The voile fabric lets soft natural light through while providing some privacy and filtering strong midday sun. Suited to bedrooms, living rooms, and front windows.

A small magnetic dry erase whiteboard with a lightweight aluminum frame and a white writing surface. Useful for notes, lists, dates, and drawings, and it also works as a bulletin board for magnetic items. Comes with a marker and magnets and can be hung horizontally or vertically.

specs.contents: 5 sandwich bags, 5 snack bags, 2 large storage bags
specs.features: Leakproof zip lock seal, transparent, freezer safe

record.description: A set of twelve reusable zip-top bags made from food-grade PEVA plastic that is free of BPA and PVC. Includes sandwich, snack, and large bags for packing lunches, storing produce, freezing portions, and carrying snacks. The transparent design lets you see contents at a glance, and two sealing clips are included. Not for microwave, oven, or dishwasher use.
A seven-pack of long-sleeve bodysuits for baby girls in an assorted set, sized 18 months. Each bodysuit features strong snaps designed to hold up through repeated washing and everyday wear.

specs.certifications: Non-GMO, gluten free, dairy free, vegan-friendly
specs.key ingredients: Amla extract, proline, glycine, white tea extract

record.description: A vanilla-flavored plant-based protein powder designed to support the body's own collagen production. It blends plant proteins, amino acids, and botanical extracts aimed at skin hydration, joint comfort, and healthy hair and nails. Free of dairy, gluten, and soy; can be mixed into shakes, smoothies, or coffee.

Six refill bulbs in a warm pumpkin scent blended with sweet butter and vanilla cream and a touch of spice. They fit Wallflower plugs and night-lights to freshen a room for weeks. This fragrance has been discontinued, so it can be hard to find.

specs.origin: Eastern Europe (Russia, Romania, Croatia, Serbia, Ukraine, and others)

record.description: A mixed box of pre-packaged snacks made in Eastern European countries such as Russia, Romania, Croatia, Serbia, and Ukraine. Each box holds at least eight treats, such as candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, and pretzels, and the exact mix varies from box to box.

specs.fitment: Universal manual and automatic vehicles without shift button

record.description: A black skull-styled gear shift knob made from resin with aluminum alloy attachments. It is designed for manual and automatic cars without a shift-lock button.

specs.included: 6 packets of transparent water gels for floating

record.description: Ivory faux plastic pearls with a smooth, hole-free finish, sized in three diameters for vase fillers, table scatter, and decorative centerpieces. Includes six packets of water gel that make the pearls float. Reusable and suitable for weddings, showers, anniversaries, and other events.

specs.product type: Travel system (stroller and infant car seat)

specs.configurations: 3 strollers in 1: infant bassinet, infant car seat carrier, toddler stroller

A white plastic tray sized to hold a 24-inch flower box. It catches drips and protects decks, patios, or indoor surfaces beneath window boxes. The flower box is not included; only the tray is sold.

specs.dimensions: 10.25 x 16 x 5.5 inches (L x W x H)

specs.type: Undershelf storage basket with snug fit arms

A compact brass fountain pen from Kaweco with a fine gold-plated steel nib. Its light, pocket-sized body is made by hand in Nuremberg and offers a smooth, soft writing feel in a classic style.

Blue self-fanning volume eyelash extensions for lash technicians new to hand-made volume sets. A sticky base strip helps keep fans together, and the lashes are heat-set for a stable curl. Lengths run 14-20mm at 0.07mm thickness.

A wall-mounted coat rack with five metal hooks for hanging coats, hats, bags, and umbrellas. Its weathered white distressed wood finish adds rustic style to entryways, bedrooms, and kitchens. Mounting hardware is included for simple installation, and the rack holds up to 30 pounds.

specs.load capacity: 200 pounds or more when installed properly

record.description: A stainless steel hanger with a chain for drying and storing fishing or hunting waders and wader boots. Hang them in a closet or from a branch to keep them off the ground and help them hold their shape between uses.

specs.construction: Bonded fleece with grid knit texture

record.description: A warm men's full-zip jacket with a grid-knit exterior and soft Sherpa fleece lining. Suited to layering over a shirt on cool days or under an insulated shell in colder weather. Features an embroidered logo, two side zip pockets, and a full front zipper.

specs.dimensions: 23 in high x 16 in wide x 25 in long

record.description: A step stair that helps dogs reach couches and raised beds. Its gentle incline lowers the number of steps needed to climb. Suitable for dogs of any size, it has a carpeted tread that comes off for simple cleaning. Made of molded plastic in a chocolate finish.

A slim multifunction pen that twists between a black ballpoint, a red ballpoint, and a 0.5mm pencil. The cap holds a stylus for touch screens and an eraser sits beneath it. Satin black finish with chrome accents. Personalization with engraved name or message is available.

specs.care: Machine Washable

record.description: A black short-sleeve football fan t-shirt featuring a Raiders-themed graphic design. Made of 100% cotton, pre-shrunk for consistent sizing, and machine washable. Screen printed in the USA and available in sizes Small through 5X.

specs.footbed: Soft EVA with anatomical arch support

record.description: Casual boys' sandals with a vegan leather strap lined in jersey for a soft fit around the foot. A soft EVA footbed provides arch support, and the flexible EVA construction moves with the foot. The molded outsole offers multi-directional grip.

A white home jersey for kids in the Real Madrid 2019-20 style, with a classic look and gold accents. It has a regular, slightly loose fit with a crewneck and short sleeves. Made from recycled polyester with sweat-wicking fabric and mesh under the arms for comfort.
An HDTV cable for connecting a Sega Saturn console to a high-definition television. It supports 720p resolution for clear picture and crisp audio, and includes a 6 ft. Micro cable.

specs.fits: Oakley Holbrook, model numbers starting OO9102

record.description: A pair of replacement lenses with a dark silver mirror coating, designed to fit Oakley Holbrook sunglass frames with model numbers starting OO9102. The lenses are polarized to reduce glare and offer UV protection. The frame is not included.

specs.footbed: Molded EVA with arch support, heel cup, and toe bar

A heavyweight jumbo pet bowl for extra large dogs, with a rubber base that grips slippery floors like tile and linoleum to limit sliding during meals. The bowl is dishwasher safe, and it comes in assorted colors that vary by unit.

An unframed LEGO Batman grid wall poster printed from high-resolution artwork on gloss poster paper. Measuring 22.375 by 34 inches, it can be framed or hung with clips, push pins, or poster mounts. Suits bedrooms, kids' rooms, party decor, and other spaces.

A three-pack of sleeveless toddler boys' tank tops in blue stripe, orange gator, and gray stripe patterns. Features a ribbed neckline and a pocket detail. Tagless packaging for everyday comfort, sized 3T.

Large double wall corrugated bottom for consolidating multiple-piece shipments. Built from heavy kraft corrugate to hold bulky, irregularly shaped items. Ships flat by the pallet. Pairs with the matching Gaylord lid.

specs.compartments: 2 main zippered pockets, 1 front zippered pocket, anti-theft interlayer
specs.features: External USB charging port and side headphone hole

It carries a phone, small tablet, keys, wallet and cards across several organized pockets. An external USB port and a side opening for earphone cables add everyday convenience, and it can be worn across the chest or over one shoulder.

specs.design: Older woman and young girl holding hands, seated on gray bench
specs.packaging: Fitted gift box with enclosure card

record.description: A hand-painted resin figurine showing a grandmother and granddaughter holding hands on a gray bench, both in cream dresses. It celebrates the bond between grandparent and child, comes boxed as a gift, and can join other pieces in a family grouping.

specs.blade type: Replaceable premium wire cutters, four outside-opening blades

record.description: A heavy-duty multitool with 21 tools, including large pliers, replaceable wire cutters, and spring-action scissors. All tools open and lock with one hand. Comes with a nylon sheath and lanyard ring for easy carrying. Backed by a 25-year warranty.

specs.includes: Matching chef hat with velcro fastener

Thermal 3MM neoprene gloves for snorkeling, kayaking, surfing, diving and other water sports. They offer a flexible, stretchy fit, a grippy palm for holding small items, and a wrist strap to keep out sand. Not fully waterproof; designed to pair with a wetsuit.

A compact USB-C hub with four USB 3.0 ports for keyboards, mice, flash drives and hard drives, plus a USB-C port that passes through up to 60W of charging power. Plug-and-play setup with no external drivers. Works with many USB-C laptops and tablets, though some older Mac models are not supported. Aluminum body with an LED indicator.
A museum-quality poster featuring Oversoul, an artwork by Alex Grey, presented as an official item. The print measures 18 by 24 inches and suits framing for display in homes, studios, or offices.

A foldable rocking camp chair with a powder-coated steel frame and breathable TechMesh seat. A low-profile rocker locks in place for steady leaning back. Folds compactly and comes with a shoulder bag for easy carrying and storage. Supports up to 300 pounds.

specs.product: Child's Play 2 Good Guys batteries (prop accessory)

record.description: Officially licensed Good Guys battery accessory from the Child's Play 2 film, designed as a companion piece for a Good Guys doll. Sold as a two-pack of size D batteries for display and collectible play.
